evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# @dsh/remote-ops

DeepSeek Harness plugin for SSH, Windows desktop, web and RESTful API operations. Users and Agents share visible terminals, application windows, webpages and request records.

## Visible, draggable browser scrollbars (v0.19.1)

Embedded horizontal and vertical scrollbars use contrasting thumbs and tracks according to the webpage’s declared color scheme. Hold and drag a thumb, including releasing outside the panel. Workspace changes, page changes and connection failures release the drag. Native scrollbar dimensions, webpage layout and CSS-pixel coordinates are preserved, with no additional display settings.

The embedded CSS viewport follows the available Sidebar width and height, like resizing a Chrome window. Pages reflow at their normal font size; wide and long content scrolls inside the webpage. Resizing does not reload the document or clear login state and drafts. Website layout rules remain in effect. Users and Agents share the page; recordings retain browser CSS pixels. After a panel resize, obtain a fresh observation before using refs or coordinates. An in-flight action finishes before the newest size is applied.

## Browser discovery and visual actions (v0.17.0)

Agents inspect menu structure and element references first, then request an actual screenshot when the entry remains unclear. They can click or hover screenshot coordinates without waiting for a locator timeout. Official Playwright MCP runs in memory on the existing browser context. The bundled skill guides observation, actions and result verification. Screenshots go to the configured DSH image-capable model; text-only models can still use structured snapshots. See [usage and network boundaries](BROWSER-MCP.md).

## Compact navigation and readable terminals (v0.16.2)

The first row contains **Terminal, Web, Desktop, Files and API**, with **Settings** fixed on the right. The terminal's second row starts with a distinct **Environment** button outside the scrolling session tabs, followed by the terminal actions. Use **返回** (Back) at the top left of the environment drawer, or Esc, to return to the same workspace. Web, Desktop, Files and API also expose environment management beside their connection controls.

Commands are blue and directories teal in both light and dark themes. **Settings → Terminal → 文字对比度保护** (text contrast protection) is on by default. It adjusts only unreadable foreground colors in ANSI 16-color, 256-color and truecolor output to at least 4.5:1 contrast, preserving backgrounds and text. Turn it off for original ANSI colors. Copy, search, tool reads and log export remain unchanged. Full-screen programs receive no semantic command highlighting but can still use contrast protection.

## Local terminals on demand (v0.16.0)

Startup opens **one default local terminal**, initially CMD on Windows. The **+** beside the terminal tabs opens another default terminal; its dropdown opens CMD, Windows PowerShell 5.1, PowerShell 7 or one installed WSL distribution. Unavailable entries are disabled with a reason. Install PowerShell 7 or WSL distributions on the DSH host first, then use **Settings → Terminal → Redetect**.

**Settings → Terminal → Local terminal** stores the default shell and starting directory, plus an optional WSL user. Use `~` or an absolute Linux path for WSL. Saving affects future opens and the next startup; existing processes remain unchanged. An empty Windows directory uses `$DSH_HOME/remote-ops`. Local terminals are shared across conversations in the DSH workspace, with separate processes, output and logs. A restart opens only the default, without restoring additional tabs.

The default tab stays pinned; additional local tabs can be closed individually. After `exit`, the tab turns grey and retains its last output with an explicit **Reopen terminal** action. Reopening never replays commands. **Close all** remains limited to current-conversation remote tabs and preserves every local terminal. Copy/paste, echoed-command highlighting and TXT/ZIP export work across local terminals. Log retention is bounded and in memory; export required records before restarting.

Agents load the bundled `remote-ops-environments` skill, discover engines and sessions with `remote_local_shells`, then call `remote_local_open`. It reuses a matching running session with no known active task by default; use `reuse:false` for an independent process. Route subsequent operations to its returned `sessionId`. The pinned default retains the legacy ID `local-cmd`; inspect `shell` instead of assuming CMD syntax.

## Encrypted SSH private keys (v0.15.12)

In **环境 → 终端环境**, create or edit an SSH environment and enter the private key path on the DSH host. Enter the key’s decryption passphrase in **私钥口令（可选）**. Leave it empty for an unencrypted key. DSH stores the account password and key passphrase separately. Leaving the passphrase blank while editing keeps the saved value. To remove it, select **清除已保存的私钥口令** and save. Use the environment’s Test or Connect action to verify the login.

## Collapsible environment groups (v0.15.4)

Click a group name in the environment drawer to collapse or expand it. Groups start expanded. Terminal and API environments remember their groups independently. Searching reveals matches and clearing the search restores your layout. Bulk selection includes only visible environments in expanded groups.

## Environment drawer and compact toolbar (v0.15.3)

Environments open in a left drawer inside the plugin: overlay by default, optionally pinned on wide panels, and full width on narrow panels. Escape restores focus; drafts, terminal sessions, webpages and recordings remain available. Compact toolbars and row More menus free workspace space. Verified locally with DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5.

## Web recordings and bundled browser (v0.15.2)

Start, stop, read and export human/Agent webpage operations from the Web toolbar or `remote_browser_recording`. The bundled `remote-ops-web-recordings` skill teaches the Agent to interpret records, parameterize device addresses and generate code in the user's chosen framework or template.

Windows x64 and Linux x64 packages include the embedded Chromium. The plugin prepares it offline on load and the first page open waits for it. Linux requires Chromium system libraries. Sites using the matching intranet bridge can upgrade v0.14.0 and v0.14.1 with one click in the plugin. The ZIP includes deployment instructions.

## Serial terminals (v0.14.1)

In **Environments → Terminal environments → Add**, select **SERIAL** beside SSH and TELNET. Select a port or enter the device path available to the plugin host, such as `COM3`, `/dev/ttyUSB0`, or `/dev/cu.usbserial-001`. Set the baud rate, data bits, stop bits, parity, flow control, encoding and line ending to match the device. Defaults are 9600 baud, 8N1, no flow control and CR. Save and enter the environment to open its terminal tab.

The user and Agent share input, device output and log exports. Agents can list ports with `remote_serial_ports`, save `transport: "serial"` with `serial.path` through `remote_environment_create`, then use the existing terminal tools. Only one connection can own a port at a time. Closing the tab releases it. The connection test opens and closes the port; inspect device output to verify commands.

## Save environment credentials from chat (v0.13.2)

When you explicitly provide an account/password for an environment, the Agent can create or update it directly. SSH/Telnet use `username` and `password` in `remote_environment_create/update`; API uses `auth.username` and a top-level `password` in `remote_api_environment_save`. GUI entry remains optional.

Passwords go to DSH credentials; environment files store references and tool results omit plaintext. Replacing a password affects only that environment. Omit/null preserves it; an empty string is rejected. Choose either password or passwordRef. Existing terminals stay connected; API environments require login again after edits. DSH manages its own conversation and tool-call history.

## Telnet terminals (v0.13.1)

Choose **Environments → Terminal environments → Add**, select Telnet, and save the host, port (default 23) and login mode. Supports username/password, password-only, no-login and manual terminal login. Automatic credentials are submitted once; a failed login leaves the output available for inspection.

Users and Agents share the visible terminal, tabs, status indicators and log exports. Close all now includes this conversation's SSH, TELNET and SERIAL tabs while keeping local CMD. Connection, login readiness and command results are separate. Configure encoding, line endings and prompt patterns for device CLIs. Telnet is unencrypted; file transfer uses SSH/SFTP.

Existing `remote_environment_*` and `remote_terminal_*` tools and bundled skills cover the flow without Agent changes. See the [Telnet guide](TELNET.md).

## Windows desktop operations

The **桌面** workspace shows real Windows application windows. Connect the DSH Windows host or a saved Windows SSH environment, launch software, inspect UIA controls, fill fields, click buttons and verify outcomes. Users can operate the same window; native DSH cancellation stops later steps. Export this conversation's desktop records and last captured windows as a ZIP.

The tgz includes the pinned worker and dependencies plus the native `remote-ops-desktop` skill. Use a logged-on, unlocked Windows 11 or Windows Server Desktop Experience session; the SSH account must match that desktop user. Hot reload waits for active desktop work and retains connections and logs. See the [Windows desktop guide](DESKTOP.md).

Start with [remote Windows setup](DESKTOP.md#远程电脑的一次性配置), then copy the [complete Notepad task](DESKTOP.md#完整示例打开记事本输入并保存) into DSH (guide in Chinese). It opens a new document, enters text and saves through the application UI, then reads the saved file independently over SSH to verify its contents.

## Hot reload after updates

v0.12.3 also supports hosts that reload plugins during package installation. When needed, it first waits for active work and preserves the running state before installing; final activation still waits for idle. Update submission returns immediately while the operation continues in the background. Brief connection gaps recover automatically; persistent failures show the request address and details. **刷新更新状态** reads progress without repeating installation. An installation that has not returned after 10 minutes explicitly reports an unconfirmed result.

Starting with v0.11.0, **设置 → 更新 → 检查并更新** downloads, verifies and installs a newer release, then automatically applies it when work is idle. DSH keeps running. The update view explains waits for conversation activity, terminal waits and independent commands, transfers, browser jobs/runtime installation, and API requests. Browser uploads defer reload until the whole batch finishes or is cancelled, including the gaps between file requests.

The handoff preserves the current conversation and draft, saved settings, live terminal/browser connections, terminal logs, and API authentication and records. No command or request is replayed. Output silence is not treated as proof that a manual terminal command finished: its connection is retained. New connections use the new implementation; existing transports retain the implementation they were created with.

A failed startup restores the previous runtime and exposes **重试应用已安装版本** (retry activation). Running and installed versions remain distinct. Missing host reload APIs or an incompatible runtime state format produce an explicit restart requirement.

**For the first migration from v0.12.2 or earlier, finish active work and install this tgz through DSH plugin management or the CLI.** After CLI installation, if the running version is still old and the page responds, use **重试应用已安装版本** in the update settings to activate the installed package without reinstalling it. Hosts without hot-reload support need a restart. If the old updater is already stuck, check the host installation log and installed version, then restart DSH once after installation completes; do not submit another install. Subsequent compatible updates from the fixed runtime can hot reload. A full restart requires reconnecting terminals and webpages but preserves saved configuration and conversations. Refreshing the browser alone does not update the backend. See the [v0.12.3 acceptance record](https://github.com/Ssshake1996/myterm/blob/main/docs/testing/dsh-remote-ops-v0.12.3-acceptance.md).

## Remote tab status and close all

The terminal strip exposes **全部关闭** (close all). It closes the current conversation's SSH tabs and their connections captured when clicked, preserving local CMD, saved environments and other conversations. Live connections or known running commands receive one combined confirmation with an active-operation count; disconnected tabs without running commands clear immediately. Failed closures remain visible with a reason. Connections opened during confirmation are excluded from that selection.

| Indicator | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Amber ring | Waiting for output, executing an independent command or closing; hover for the specific state and whether the Agent initiated it |
| Green dot | Connected; not proof that a command finished or a business operation succeeded |
| Hollow gray dot | Disconnected without a known running command; received output is retained for inspection or export |

Shapes, text and accessible descriptions accompany the colors; blue still marks the selected tab. Amber is informational and human input remains available. Ordinary keystrokes and new output are not treated as reliably timed command executions.

Closing cancels associated waits and independent commands and requests SSH channel shutdown. Remote process termination remains unconfirmed; commands are not replayed. Closing tabs does not erase retained logs, which remain available through log tools or **更多 → 一键打包本会话全部日志** within the retention limits.

## Windows OpenSSH

Windows desktop and Server use the existing SSH environment, terminal, file and log workspaces. Choose the target platform and server-default, CMD, Windows PowerShell 5.1 or an installed PowerShell 7 in **环境 → 终端环境 → SSH**. **测试** reports authentication, detected system, PTY, SFTP and the host fingerprint separately.

`remote_environment_create/update/test` manages and diagnoses targets. `remote_command_execute` accepts a Windows shell, literal working directory and named PowerShell parameters, and returns exit status and separate error output. Windows independent commands authenticate a separate SSH connection while preserving the visible terminal. SFTP handles drive paths, Unicode and spaces; existing file and multi-terminal log tools remain available.

The package includes the native DSH `remote-ops-windows` skill. See the [Windows guide](WINDOWS.md) and [verification matrix](https://github.com/Ssshake1996/myterm/blob/main/docs/testing/dsh-remote-ops-v0.10.2-acceptance.md). No Agent modification is required.

## Workspace tabs

Terminal, Web, Files and API now form a compact left-aligned group. The blue selection line spans the complete tab button. Narrow panels use smaller padding while retaining labels, background activity badges and arrow / Home / End navigation. Switching preserves workspace contents.

## Terminal layout and request diagnostics

- Session tabs, close all, search and the current TXT download share one row, with approximately 32px desktop tabs. All-log ZIP export lives under **更多**; the bottom status bar shows the path, quick commands remain below, and **设置 → 终端** controls the active SSH size.
- Error headings distinguish state refresh, terminal output refresh and plugin update failures. Expand **错误详情** for the request method, redacted URL, HTTP status, stage, timestamp and bounded response preview. Network failures explicitly say that no HTTP response was received.
- Update failures identify the version manifest, SHA256 file or archive, including the actual failed URL. Upstream HTTP status and the plugin endpoint status are labeled separately.
- The same background refresh failure is automatically announced once per DSH/plugin runtime. Dismissing it, switching workspaces or refreshing the page does not repeatedly reopen it. Background retries continue; explicit **刷新状态** still reports its result. Recovery clears the corresponding state error; a new backend runtime enables notifications again.
- Diagnostics redact URL query values and common password, Token, Cookie and Authorization fields. They do not collect request bodies or headers.

For a 404, first identify whether the failed URL is `/api/dsh-remote-ops/state` or an update-source file, then check plugin loading, service routing or the release directory accordingly. Version checks remain manual.

## Workspace layout

- All workspaces share one **设置** entry with general, terminal, browser and update categories. **环境** manages SSH and API environments together, retaining their separate forms and credentials.
- Local CMD and SSH use one consistent terminal tab strip, with a filled background, border and bold text for the active tab. Arrow keys switch terminals. Environments open in a drawer on the left of the plugin workspace, with a persistent close button. Escape closes it and restores focus to the environment entry, retaining terminal and request drafts. The terminal row contains close all, search, current TXT download and **更多** (more). Quick commands start as a compact strip; expand it or open **命令库** to manage saved commands.
- Workspace tabs show unread terminal output, file transfers and browser execution. Viewing the corresponding terminal clears its unread indicator. Transfers show a percentage only when the total is known reliably.
- API results have **响应 / 记录** tabs. Expand JSON nodes and click a field name to copy its JSON Pointer, with selectable text when clipboard access fails. HTTP status uses both color and text; 2xx also says **请检查业务结果**. Large trees render in batches and retain a raw view.
- Workspace/settings switches preserve terminal, browser and API state. Background work continues while hidden browser views suspend frame requests.

## Manual intranet HTTP/HTTPS updates

Open Remote Ops → **设置 → 更新**, save a source, then choose **仅检查版本** (check only) or **检查并更新** (check and install). Choose the default GitHub Release source or an intranet HTTP/HTTPS URL. Clicking a button starts the check; a newer stable version can then be installed. Running and installed versions are shown separately. Compatible updates automatically activate when ongoing work finishes; the view reports the waiting reason and the resulting running version.

Keep `latest.json`, `dsh-remote-ops-v0.19.1.tgz` and `SHA256SUMS-dsh-remote-ops-v0.19.1.txt` in the feed directory. Generate the manifest from the unchanged official release pair:

```sh
node integrations/dsh-remote-ops/scripts/create-update-manifest.mjs ./release/dsh-remote-ops-v0.19.1.tgz
```

The installed package also includes `scripts/create-update-manifest.mjs`. An optional second argument chooses an existing parent directory's `latest.json`, allowing version subdirectories. The script verifies checksum and package identity, refuses a lower version, and writes the manifest atomically. Upload the tgz/checksum first and publish the manifest last. Serve the directory over HTTP/HTTPS. GitHub Release provides the tgz and SHA256 checksum file.

- HTTP(S): use a directly readable directory URL or `latest.json` URL containing the scheme, host and path. All files and redirects must remain on that origin; the server must allow the DSH host to download them directly. Trust internal HTTPS certificates in the DSH Node process.
- Dependencies use the DSH registry, proxy and build-approval configuration. Provide an accessible internal npm registry when needed. The embedded browser ships with the plugin. Full Chromium for independent windows is optional.

Verified packages are cached on the DSH host and installed by the current profile's native DSH plugin manager. Source settings live in `$DSH_HOME/remote-ops/update-settings.json` and are shared within that DSH home; installation affects the current profile. Installation errors provide a reason and log location. Failed hot reload restores the previous runtime and allows an explicit activation retry. Follow the activation or restart steps above for the first migration; a full restart does not restore process-local connections or records. The bundled `remote-ops-updates` skill covers configuration, feed generation and diagnostics.

## Saved RESTful environments and execution workspace

- The **API** workspace saves base URLs, groups, common headers, timeout, private CA and login configuration. API targets work without SSH; an optional SSH environment ID links the same device without sharing credentials.
- A single POST login sends username/password as JSON or form and extracts a Token through JSON Pointer or a response header, or stores scoped Cookies. Cookie-to-CSRF-header mapping is supported. Passwords use DSH credentials; configuration stores references. Login sessions are isolated by conversation and remain in memory only.
- UI and Agent requests share visible login/request records, HTTP status, timing, redacted responses, errors and unknown outcomes. Export the current conversation's records as JSON. HTTP 2xx still requires checking the business response.
- The bundled `remote-ops-api` skill guides Agent operations: select a target with `remote_api_environment_list`, manage it with `remote_api_environment_save/delete`, then use exact returned IDs with `remote_api_login`, `remote_api_request` and `remote_api_records`.
- Requests originate on the DSH host. Both `/items` and `items` preserve the base URL's path prefix. No automatic redirects, reauthentication or replay. After a timeout/cancellation with an unknown outcome, query device state before any retry.
- Configuration persists in `$DSH_HOME/remote-ops/api/environments.json`; login state, records and duplicate-ID protection cover only this process's last 100 requests per conversation. Response preview: 128 KiB; request body: 1 MiB. Edits invalidate login; running requests keep their captured target. Switching tabs does not cancel requests.
- Credentials and known authentication values are redacted; business payloads may still contain sensitive data.

## Local CMD commands and directory colors

The terminal follows the DSH light/dark theme with blue commands, teal directories and blue file names. Text contrast protection is enabled by default. Error, warning and success prefixes also receive emphasis; verify outcomes from the actual output. Surrounding plugin controls use host styling.

Commands echoed after a standard prompt now use the same accent, weight and subtle background whether typed manually, sent as a complete Agent command or entered through raw keys. Recognition runs after terminal cursor redraws, so visible edits/backspaces remain readable. No extra command is executed and hidden input is never added to the display.

Standard `dir` rows show directory names in teal and file names in blue, leaving timestamps, sizes and totals unchanged. ANSI backgrounds are preserved; contrast protection adjusts unreadable foreground colors. Common CMD, PowerShell and `user@host` Shell prompts are recognized; custom prompts and formats without type information, such as `dir /b`, are not guessed. Full-screen applications do not receive these semantic colors. Terminal display settings can disable them; copied, searched and exported text stays unchanged.

## Reveal environment passwords on demand

The SSH password field in the environment editor has an eye button. It stays masked by default and resolves the currently effective saved credential only on request. Hiding the password or closing the editor/drawer clears the revealed value. Newly typed passwords can also be shown for checking.

Viewing alone never changes the credential: saving other fields preserves it; typing a replacement updates it. Missing configuration, missing credentials and unavailable providers have clear retry/re-entry messages. Revealed values are not written to browser storage, environment listings, diagnostic records or Agent tool results. The bundled environment-management skill describes the user-facing path.

## Terminal copy and paste

Local CMD, SSH, Telnet and Serial terminals share copy/paste behavior. Select output and press `Ctrl+C`, or right-click and choose **复制选中内容**. With no selection, `Ctrl+C` remains the terminal interrupt signal. `Ctrl+V` and **粘贴到终端** send clipboard text to the active session; single-line text is sent immediately, while multiline text opens a confirmation dialog before submission.

The context menu also provides **全选输出**. Copied text is plain text without terminal colors or cursor decoration. If browser clipboard permission is unavailable, the UI explains the reason and you can select text manually or type it. Copy/paste changes only the visible terminal; it does not change Agent tools or add hidden input to retained logs.

## Terminal logs

- The download button beside terminal tabs exports the current terminal as UTF-8 TXT. **更多 → 一键打包本会话全部日志** exports all available conversation logs as ZIP, including retained closed SSH records and the shared local terminal. Each ZIP contains separate transcripts and a `manifest.json` with source, time and coverage metadata.
- `remote_terminal_logs`, `remote_terminal_log_read` and `remote_terminal_log_export` provide discovery, raw-cursor pagination and packaging. The export tool returns SHA256 and an absolute download link for the observed trusted DSH browser origin (or null when unavailable; use the toolbar); the Agent need not copy screen text, read every page or run archive commands.
- The bundled `remote-ops-terminal-logs` skill is automatically discoverable through DSH, with `/remote-ops-terminal-logs` also available. The tgz carries both tools and instructions.
- Retention is process memory: 4 MiB per terminal, trimmed to the latest 3 MiB on overflow; closed records share a 16 MiB / 32-record limit. APIs disclose truncation and evictions. History does not survive restart. Hidden/raw input is not logged separately, but secrets printed by programs can still be present.
- A package accepts at most 32 logs / 32 MiB raw output. Download cache is limited to 10 packages / 32 MiB; links expire after one hour, earlier eviction or host restart. Exports freeze current buffers; later output needs a new export. Progress frames are retained as lines, not a replay of a full-screen application. Independent commands and browser activity are separate records.

## Agent environment management

`remote_environment_list/create/update/delete` manages SSH environment definitions. The bundled `remote-ops-environments` skill covers targets, updates, groups, credentials and existing connections. It registers through DSH's native skill provider; user/project skills retain their normal precedence.

## Interface and interaction

- Terminal, web, files, environments, saved commands and diagnostics share consistent typography, spacing, controls and host-aware light/dark surfaces. Workspace tabs stay at the top; version, diagnostics and comfortable/compact density live under **设置 → 通用**. Updates live under **设置 → 更新**. Density persists in this browser.
- Local CMD and SSH share one tab row with search and export fixed on the right. When tabs overflow, left and right buttons scroll to earlier or later tabs without closing connections; each button is disabled at its boundary. Arrow keys and Home/End select and reveal a terminal. Background output and status refreshes preserve manual scrolling.
- The web workspace prioritizes the address and live page. **设置 → 网页** contains engines and browser runtime status. **收藏** manages sites and flows; **操作记录** expands below the live page. Returning to the workspace retains the URL draft and current page.
- Switching an open page between embedded and independent display requires confirmation. Cancel dispatches nothing; confirming reloads the page and may lose unsent form content. Switching cannot be submitted repeatedly while pending.
- File batch actions appear after selection. Upload controls match other buttons, and browser uploads show byte progress. Module switches retain selection, drafts and background jobs; completed transfers still use coalesced directory refreshes.

The left action opens the native DSH right sidebar. Human and Agent input is shared; use native conversation cancellation to stop the Agent.

## Embedded browser and independent windows

On Windows x64 and Linux x64 the plugin verifies its bundled Headless Shell in a per-user cache when it loads. Opening an embedded URL waits for local preparation and restores damaged cache files from the plugin. Linux requires Chromium's system libraries. Full Chromium for independent windows is optional.

- Independent windows follow the Windows user's default HTTP(S) browser on the DSH host, supporting installed Chrome / Edge with an isolated plugin profile. Embedded mode still defaults to matching Chromium. Each mode has its own engine preference. Explicit saved-site or tool browser choices take precedence. Unsupported/unavailable defaults report an error instead of silently opening Edge. A remote DSH host's default is separate from the client viewing DSH.
- Prefer an action array for `steps`. Single action objects, a sole `{steps:[...]}` envelope and JSON-encoded versions are accepted. Prefer `{kind,value,name?,frame?}` locator objects for `target`; JSON-encoded locator objects and CSS/XPath strings (`css=#id`, `xpath=//button`, `#id`, `//button`) are accepted. All steps normalize and validate before dispatch. Equivalent requests deduplicate under the same `requestId

# 额度恢复自动续跑

当模型请求因为**额度或限流**失败时，让任务自己继续跑，不需要人工再敲一句“继续”。

插件不区分厂商，只读 LLM 层已经归一化的失败码（`QUOTA`、`ACCOUNT_QUOTA`、`RATE_LIMIT`），
因此对官方 DeepSeek、OpenCode Go、以及任何把这些限制归类到上述码的 OpenAI 兼容路由都成立。

## 两条恢复通道

| 通道 | 什么时候用 | 你会看到什么 |
|---|---|---|
| **同轮重试** | 等待很短：`Retry-After` 不超过 `inlineMaxMs`，或 `QUOTA` / `RATE_LIMIT` 先做几次秒级退避 | 没有中断。同一个 turn 重新发出刚才那一步请求，从断点继续。 |
| **暂停 + 定时唤醒** | 属于窗口型额度（5 小时 / 每周 / 每月），或需要的等待超过 `inlineMaxMs` | 当前 turn 带着厂商错误正常收尾；到预计重置时间，同一会话收到一条 `[quota-resume]` 继续指令，自动开始下一轮。 |

唤醒时间到了但额度还没恢复时，插件会按 `probeInitialMs` 翻倍（上限 `probeMaxMs`）再安排一次，
所以它不需要预先知道真实重置时刻也能逐步逼近。会话一旦成功产出一条助手消息，
遗留的唤醒任务会被自动删除，不会在之后多触发一轮。

唤醒本身是 Host 计划任务里的一次性任务，投递到同一个 Session，因此**跨重启有效**；
Host 关闭期间错过的那次，会在下次启动时补投。

## 安装

要求 DeepSeek Harness 已装好并至少运行过一次（存在 profile）。

**从 npm 安装**（推荐）：让 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle` 指向 `dsh-quota-resume`，
它会按当前版本装进 profile。

**从目录安装**（本地开发用）：

1. 打开 **插件（Plugins）**；
2. **添加插件（Add plugin）**；
3. 选择本仓库目录（或克隆后的目录）。

两种方式都会把本包链接进 profile，并在 `cordis.patch.yml` 中插入 `quota-resume` 一行。

## 配置

所有字段都可省略，在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖该行 `config` 即可：

```yaml
- id: quota-resume
  name: dsh-quota-resume
  config:
    probeInitialMs: 300000
    providers:
      - dsh-opencode-go
```

| 字段 | 默认值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关。 |
| `handleQuota` | `true` | 是否处理 `QUOTA`。 |
| `handleRateLimit` | `true` | 是否处理 `RATE_LIMIT`。 |
| `handleBalance` | `false` | 是否把 `ACCOUNT_QUOTA`（账户余额）也当作窗口来处理。默认关闭，因为等待并不能把余额等回来。 |
| `providers` | `[]` | 只处理这些 provider；为空表示全部。 |
| `exemptProviders` | `[]` | 忽略这些 provider。 |
| `quotaRetries` | `2` | `QUOTA` 在暂停前先做几次同轮重试。 |
| `quotaBaseMs` | `20000` | `QUOTA` 的首次同轮退避，之后逐次翻倍。 |
| `rateLimitRetries` | `3` | `RATE_LIMIT` 在暂停前先做几次同轮重试。 |
| `rateLimitBaseMs` | `5000` | `RATE_LIMIT` 的首次同轮退避。 |
| `inlineMaxMs` | `300000` | 单个 turn 里最多肯等多久；厂商给的 `Retry-After` 超过它就直接暂停。 |
| `probeInitialMs` | `600000` | 首次探测的等待时间。 |
| `probeMaxMs` | `3600000` | 探测等待翻倍的上限。 |
| `maxProbes` | `0` | 最多探测几次；`0` 表示不限。 |
| `probeJitterRatio` | `0.1` | 探测等待的对称抖动比例。 |
| `fallbackDelayMs` | `300000` | 无法建立定时唤醒时（例如委派子会话）退回到同轮重试的等待时间。 |
| `resumeTitle` | `额度恢复后自动继续` | 自动化任务页里显示的任务名。 |
| `resumePrompt` | 见 `index.js` | 到点投递的继续指令正文。 |

## 实现要点

- 监听 `agent/request-error` 这个 waterfall：接管时返回 `{ kind: 'retry' }`，让 agent loop
  在同一个 turn 内重跑失败的那一步；不接管时调用 `next()`，行为与没装插件一致。
- 暂停时通过 `ctx.schedule.create()` 建一次性 `at` 任务，目标为 `{ kind: 'session', sessionId }`，
  到点由计划任务向该会话投递继续指令。
- 监听 `session/event` 中的 `assistant/message`，成功即清理本轮计数与遗留的唤醒任务。
- 零运行时依赖：不 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包，通过 `ctx.reflect.get('schedule')` 取可选服务，
  因此本地链接安装不会引入第二份 cordis/schemastery；未提供 `schedule` 服务时自动退回同轮重试。

## 已知边界

- **Host 必须运行**。桌面程序关着的时候不会自动醒来；错过的那次唤醒在下一次启动时补投。
- `ACCOUNT_QUOTA` 是余额，不是窗口，等待解决不了；默认只记日志、不重试。
- 委派子会话不能接收计划消息，此时退化为同轮重试，父会话会一直等着。
- 同轮计数与“已暂停”登记在进程内存里，重启后归零（持久任务本身仍在，只是探测间隔重新从
  `probeInitialMs` 开始）。
- 每次重试都是一次真实的模型请求。被额度拒绝的请求通常不计费，但最终成功的那次会照常计费。
- 若失败发生在已经吐出部分 token 之后，重试可能重复这截内容；额度拒绝一般发生在出词前。

## 开发

```sh
node --test test/decide.test.mjs test/runtime.test.mjs
```

- `test/decide.test.mjs`：纯决策函数——分流、退避、探测升级、配置校验。
- `test/runtime.test.mjs`：用假的 `ctx` 与假的 `schedule` 服务验证监听器接线——同轮重试、
  取消即放弃、暂停建任务、去重、余额不重试、成功后清理。

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 Sterlingfrank1

# dsh-openloop-mas

OpenLoop MAS 插件（DeepSeek Harness）。

把「会闭合的多智能体循环」带进 DSH 对话：规划 → 执行 → **机检验收** → 复盘 →
闭合 / 升级人工工单，每一轮都写进 **append-only 账本**。

## 它做什么

在 DSH 里直接可用 6 个工具：

| 工具 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `mas_run` | 跑一个闭环任务，返回状态 + 逐条验收判定 + 票数 + 账本路径 |
| `mas_status` | 当前配置、运行数、未结工单 |
| `mas_ledger` | 读闭环账本（可按 run_id 过滤） |
| `mas_tickets` | 列出人工升级工单 |
| `mas_report` | 渲染某次运行的 Markdown 报告 |
| `mas_doctor` | 运行环境自检 |

插件**不重写闭环逻辑**：它通过 MCP（stdio JSON-RPC 2.0）调用本地 OpenLoop MAS
运行时，因此 DSH 对话里的判定与账本记录和 Codex / Claude Code 客户端**完全一致**。

## 前提

- **DSH >= 0.2.2-rc.1**（声明兼容区间 `>=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0`）
- **Node.js >= 22.19**
- 已装好 OpenLoop MAS 运行时（默认在 `~/.mas`）

## 安装

前置：机器上已装好 OpenLoop MAS 运行时（默认在 `~/.mas`）。

```bash
# 从本仓库打包
cd integrations/dsh-openloop-mas
npm pack            # -> dsh-openloop-mas-0.7.13.tgz

# 装进 DSH Desktop profile
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "dsh-openloop-mas@file:<绝对路径>/dsh-openloop-mas-0.7.13.tgz"
dsh plugin --profile desktop list dsh-openloop-mas --depth 0
```

> `desktop` profile 由桌面应用独占管理，命令行会报
> `profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`。
> 这种情况下请在 DSH Desktop 的插件面板里安装，或改用 `--profile cli`。

## 配置

```json
{
  "dsh-openloop-mas": {
    "masHome": "C:/Users/<you>/.mas",
    "python": "C:/Python314/python.exe",
    "timeoutMs": 900000
  }
}
```

- `masHome`：OpenLoop MAS 安装根目录（`install.ps1` 写入的位置）。留空则只依赖
  PATH 上的 `mas` 运行时。
- `python`：解释器路径。留空则从 `masHome` 推断，再退回 `python`。
- `timeoutMs`：单次 MCP 调用超时。默认 900000（15 分钟）——闭环可能要跑好几轮。

## 前提与边界

- 本插件**只负责调用**，判定权在 OpenLoop MAS 引擎手里：机检结果永远压过模型
  主观判断；缺席的评审在 `all` 模式下判**不通过**（不闭合）。
- 插件不引入任何第三方 npm 依赖（只用 DSH 自带的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 与
  `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`）。
- `lib/mcp-client.js` **零依赖**，可以脱离 DSH 单独跑单元测试：
  `node --test integrations/dsh-openloop-mas/tests/`。

## 挂载机制（容易踩的坑）

DSH 认的字段是 **`dsh.bundle.patch`**（指向 `cordis.patch.yml`），
不是 `dsh.profile.bundles`。放错的结果是：插件被当成普通依赖装上、
**根本不挂载**，pnpm 会警告 `declares no dsh.bundle`。

挂载后，DSH 启动时自动应用 patch：

```
- insert:
    - id: openloop-mas
      name: 'dsh-openloop-mas'
      config: ...
```

工具参数 schema 必须满足 DSH 的 JSON Schema 子集：`items.additionalProperties`
要**显式**为 `true` / `false`，否则 `defineTool` 会抛 `JsonSchemaError`，
整个插件 entry 不激活（`1 entry did not activate`）。

## 与 MOKI 的分工

MOKI 资料库（`dsh-moki-library`）管的是**资料与草稿**：本地文件/文件夹/链接管理、
多格式预览、Word/Excel/PPT 隔离草稿编辑、选区协同（`Alt+D` 唤起 DSH 对话），
修改先入草稿、用户确认后才写回原文件。

OpenLoop MAS 管的是**闭环**：验收标准、机检判定、账本、人工升级。

两者可以同时装，各管一段：MOKI 负责把资料整理成一份可交付的产物，
OpenLoop MAS 负责判定这份产物到底过不过。

## 5 分钟上手

### 方式一：一条脚本（跨平台，不需要 Python 环境准备）

```bash
# macOS / Linux
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tffgwy/openloop-mas/main/install.sh | bash

# Windows（PowerShell）
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tffgwy/openloop-mas/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

脚本会自己建好虚拟环境、装好包、注册 MCP 服务、跑一遍自检。

### 方式二：pip 安装（需要 Python 3.10+）

```bash
pip install openloop-mas     # 见下方说明：这个包名目前还没上 PyPI
mas install        # 装 skills + 注册 MCP 服务器
mas demo           # 不需要任何 API Key，先看它自己跑通闭环
mas doctor         # 自检（包含 skills 漂移、运行时版本落后）
mas sync           # 把已安装的 skills 同步回包内版本
mas runtime        # 看本机装的是哪一版运行时
mas upgrade        # 把落后的旧版运行时换成当前这版
```

> **升级过、想换新版本？** 先 `mas upgrade`（换掉真正在跑的那份运行时），
> 再 `mas install`（让 MCP 注册指向新版本）。
> 只做后者的话，skills 和注册都刷新了，**但真正在跑的还是旧代码**——
> 这正是 `mas doctor` 的 `runtime` 检查现在会指出来的事。

> **关于 `pip install openloop-mas`**：这个包名**目前还没有在 PyPI 上建立**，
> 直接 pip 会得到 `No matching distribution found`。现在请用上面的**安装脚本**，
> 或从 [Releases](https://github.com/tffgwy/openloop-mas/releases/latest) 下载 wheel。
> `mas doctor` 会**实测**这个包名在 PyPI 上的状态并如实告诉你——
> 包名一旦发布，这段说明和 doctor 的检查都会自动对上。

`mas doctor` 说的是人话：每一项都解释「这是什么」，标清楚是**必需 / 建议 / 可选**，
最后给一句**结论**和一条**下一步命令**：

```
[OK  ] python（必需）
       3.14.10
       是什么：Python 版本够不够新（3.10 以上才能跑）
[注意] skill_codex（可选）
       未安装: ...\.codex\skills\mas-loop\SKILL.md（运行 mas install）
       是什么：给 Codex 装的 skill：让 Codex 会用这个闭环工具
...
小结：8 项正常，6 项注意，0 项坏了
结论：闭环能跑，但智能体接不上：skill_codex、skill_claude、skills_sync、mcp_codex、mcp_claude 还没装。
下一步：运行 mas install，一条命令装上 skill 并注册 MCP 服务。
```

三种结论的区别很重要：**闭环跑不起来**（必需项坏了）、**闭环能跑但智能体接不上**
（skill / MCP 没装）、**一切就绪**。退出码只在第一种情况下非零。

`mas install` 做的是**装 agent skills 到 Codex / Claude Code 的 skill 目录**、
**把 MCP 服务器注册进 `~/.codex/config.toml` 和 `~/.claude.json`**，
然后你可以直接开一个新终端，Codex 和 Claude Code 就认识这套闭环工作流了。

- 幂等：重复跑不会重复注册，也不会覆盖你已有的配置。
- 安全：任何被修改的配置文件都会先备份成 `*.bak-<时间戳>`。
- 不含密钥：安装过程不写入任何 API Key。

> 想看它装了什么，加 `--json`。

### 方式三：只下载一个脚本（零依赖，最适合初学者）

不用 clone、不用 pip、不用自己装任何东西——**下载一个脚本文件**，双击/执行它就行：

```powershell

```

```bash
# macOS / Linux：下载 install.sh 到任意目录，然后执行
```

脚本会自己从 GitHub Release 拉取已发布的 wheel、用标准库解开、装到

**不需要 git，不需要 pip，不需要编译工具。**

**机器上还没有 Python？脚本会自己装一个。**

- Windows：脚本会下载官方 Python 安装包，**按当前用户静默安装**
  （不需要管理员权限，不改 `PATH`，不装 py 启动器），

- macOS / Linux：脚本会调用系统自带的包管理器
  （Homebrew / apt / dnf / yum）装一个 Python 3.12。

想装固定版本（而不是"最新版"）：

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1 -Version 0.8.1
```

```bash
MAS_VERSION=0.8.1 bash install.sh
```

> 脚本默认会往 `PATH` 里加一条 `~/.mas/bin`（Windows 写当前用户的注册表）。
> 不想动 `PATH` 就加 `-SkipPath`（Windows）或 `MAS_SKIP_PATH=1`（shell）。

### 方式四：从源码安装（适合开发）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/tffgwy/openloop-mas.git
cd openloop-mas

# Windows
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1
# macOS / Linux
bash install.sh

# 不需要任何 API Key，先看它自己跑通闭环
mas demo
```

> `install.ps1` / `install.sh` 与 `mas install` 做的是同一件事，

> 后者适合 pip 安装后的机器。

> 配置文件固定在 `~/.mas/config.json`（Windows：`%USERPROFILE%\.mas\config.json`）。
> 运行账本另存在 `state_dir` 下，两者分开——换状态目录不会把配置弄丢。

`mas demo` 会离线跑三个场景，并把真实结果打出来：

```
[OK ] closure     期望=closed             实际=closed             迭代=2 票=-
[OK ] stagnation  期望=escalated          实际=escalated          迭代=4 票=T-20261111-085346-4396
[OK ] budget      期望=budget_exhausted   实际=budget_exhausted   迭代=1 票=-
```

> mock 只是模拟执行者产出草稿，验证权始终在确定性检查器手里。

## 为什么做这个

多智能体协作最常见的失败不是「模型不够聪明」，而是**循环不闭合**：

- 没有可核验的验收标准 → 大家互相说「差不多了」，谁也说服不了谁；
- 没有退出条件 → 一轮轮往下聊，token 烧完还没有结论；
- 没有过程记录 → 出问题无法复盘，无法交接，无法追责；
- 没有止损 → 一个明显走不通的任务会一直重试到超时。

Loop Engineering 要解决的就是这件事：**让「做完没有」变成一个可以被机器判定的事实。**

OpenLoop MAS 的做法是把闭环写成代码约束，而不是寄望于提示词：

| 环节 | 角色 | 产出 | 谁来判定 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 计划 | `planner` | 步骤与风险 | — |
| 执行 | `worker` | **交付物本身** | — |
| 验证 | `verifier` | 逐条验收标准的通过/不通过 + 证据 | 引擎（机检优先） |
| 复盘 | `reflector` | 失败原因与下一轮改法 | — |
| 闭合 | `lead` | **只判没人判的标准**：`close` / `revise` / `escalate` | 引擎（**最终否决权**） |

一个循环只有同时满足 **产物 + 逐条判定 + 决策 + 账本条目** 才算闭合；否则状态只有三种：`escalated`（升级人工）、`budget_exhausted`（预算止损）、`error`。**没有「差不多完成」这个状态。**

`lead` 是**顾问，不是法官**：**机检失败是事实**，这种情况**不咨询 lead**；
咨询了它也**只能填空**（机检已定的标准原样保留）。
**停滞、预算、死线**由引擎**最终否决**，lead 关不掉一个超预算的运行；
**lead 自己判不了**（`met` 读不出布尔值）就**保持未判定、继续追问**。

## 跑一个真实任务

```bash
mas run --goal "写一份 v0.1.0 的发布说明" \
  --criteria '{"id":"c1","desc":"包含版本号","check":{"type":"contains","arg":"v0.1.0"}}' \
  --criteria '{"id":"c2","desc":"不少于 200 字","check":{"type":"min_chars","arg":200}}'
```

输出：

```
状态：closed（迭代 2 次，token 2140）
账本：/home/you/.mas/ledgers/runs.jsonl
  [PASS] c1 (rule) all required strings present
  [PASS] c2 (rule) length 418 >= 200
--- 交付物预览 ---
...
```

### 支持的机检规则（由引擎判定，可复现）

| type | 含义 | 参数 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `contains` / `not_contains` | 必须包含 / 禁止包含 | `arg`（字符串或数组） |
| `min_chars` / `max_chars` | 长度上下限 | `arg`（整数） |
| `regex` | 正则命中 | `arg`（模式） |
| `lines_min` | 非空行数下限 | `arg`（整数） |
| `section` | 必须包含某个 `## 标题` | `arg`（标题名） |
| `json_keys` | JSON 对象必须包含的键 | `arg`（键数组） |

判定口径（实测确认，写标准时按这个来）：

| 类型 | 精确判定 | 容易踩的坑 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `contains` | 产物含给定字符串；`arg` 可为数组，**全部命中**才算通过 | 数组漏一项整条失败 |
| `not_contains` | 产物**不含**任何给定字符串 | 数组是「一个都不能出现」 |
| `min_chars` / `max_chars` | 产物的**字符数**（含空白与换行） | 不是字数也不是字节数 |
| `regex` | `re.search` 匹配，**自动带 DOTALL**（`.` 能跨行） | 想跨行不必加 `(?s)`；命中的是子串不是全串 |
| `lines_min` | **非空行**数（空行不计） | 段落间空行不影响计数 |
| `section` | 产物里**整行**恰好是 `## <arg>`（允许行尾空白） | **必须是二级标题 `##`**，`#`/`###` 都不算；正文里提到 `## 结论` 也**不算**；`## 结论分析` **不满足** `## 结论` |
| `json_keys` | 产物须是 JSON **对象**且含全部给定键 | 产物不是合法 JSON 直接判不通过 |

未知类型会被判为 `unjudged`（**不通过**），不会静默放过。

### 文件级机检（v0.7.15 起）：判定跟的是磁盘，不是文案

上面所有规则搜的都是**产物文本**。下面这十个搜的是**真实文件系统**——
「模型说写了」和「文件真的在」从此是两回事：

| type | 含义 | 参数 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `file_exists` | 文件存在且是普通文件 | `path` |
| `file_missing` | 文件不存在（清理类验收） | `path` |
| `file_contains` | 文件含给定字符串 | `path` + `value` |
| `file_not_contains` | 文件不含给定字符串 | `path` + `value` |
| `file_regex` | 文件内容命中正则 | `path` + `value` |
| `file_lines_min` | 非空行数下限 | `path` + `value` |
| `file_min_bytes` / `file_max_bytes` | 字节数上下限 | `path` + `value` |
| `file_sha256` | sha256 等于给定摘要 | `path` + `value` |
| `file_mtime_newer` | 修改时间晚于给定 ISO 时间戳 | `path` + `value` |

### 内容级机检（v0.7.70 起）：读的是文件**里面**，不是它的字节

上面十个搜的是**字节**。对**正文不是明文的格式**它们是瞎的：
PDF 的文字在**压缩流**里，`.docx` 本身是 **zip 包**，图片里没有文字。
下面六个**先把内容取出来再判**（只用标准库，不执行文件里的任何东西）：

| type | 含义 | 参数 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `content_contains` | 文件**内容**含给定字符串 | `path` + `value` |
| `content_not_contains` | 文件**内容**不含给定字符串 | `path` + `value` |
| `content_regex` | 文件**内容**命中正则 | `path` + `value` |
| `content_lines_min` | 内容**非空行**数下限 | `path` + `value` |
| `content_min_chars` | 内容**字符数**下限 | `path` + `value` |
| `content_format_is` | 文件**格式**等于给定格式 | `path` + `value` |

```bash
mas run --workspace ./my-project --goal "出一份 PDF 报告" \
  --criteria 'content_format_is:out/report.pdf::pdf' \
  --criteria 'content_contains:out/report.pdf::结论'
```

**格式按 magic bytes 判定**，扩展名只做兜底 —— 扩展名会撒谎，
`.txt` 里装的是 PDF，那它就是 PDF。支持的格式：`pdf` / `docx` / `xlsx` /
`pptx` / `zip` / `png` / `jpeg` / `gif` / `bmp` / `tiff` / `webp` /
`wav` / 文本类。

**读不出内容 = 不通过**（不是「无法判定」）。这是这一版最要紧的一条：
判「无法判定」的话，这条标准会**回到模型手里**，而模型说一句
「looks fine」就把它关上了 —— **没人查过的标准被关上，比不闭合更糟**。

### 统一资源索引与多格式预览（v0.7.71 起）：一个文件夹就是一份索引

```bash
mas files                  # 索引这台机器上所有工作区
mas files ./out            # 索引一个文件夹
mas preview ./out/report.pdf   # 预览一个文件
```

```bash
$ mas files ./out

[./out]  5 个文件  263.7 KB
    pdf        1 个
    image      2 个
    model      1 个
      836.0 B  pdf        report.pdf  pages 2、text chars 57
      327.0 B  image      shot.png  width 12、height 7
      117.0 B  image      liar.txt  width 4、height 4
      213.0 B  model      ascii.stl  triangles 2
      251.0 B  zip        bundle.zip  members 2
```

**格式按文件自己的头判定，不看名字** —— 上面的 `liar.txt` 其实是一张 PNG，
所以它报 `image`。**读不开的文件会列出来并写明原因**（那一行 ⚠ 是信息，
不是噪声：交付物中间有一个读不开的文件，恰恰是读者最该看见的东西）。

`mas preview` 把 PDF 的字从**压缩流**里取出来、把 Word 的字从 **zip 成员**里
剥掉标记取出来；图片没有正文时**明确说「没有可预览的正文」**，而不是给你一个空白屏幕。
文件不存在或传了目录 → **退出码 2**。

详见 **[docs/resources.md](docs/resources.md)**（含与
[MOKI 资料库](https://github.com/JKZeng-cell/moki-library-for-dsh) 的分工对照）。

### 草稿层（v0.7.72 起）：改动先进草稿，人确认后才写回原文件

```bash
mas drafts                              # 看有哪些草稿在等
mas drafts show D-1a2b3c4d              # 看这一份的 diff
mas drafts approve D-1a2b3c4d           # 批准：写回原文件
mas drafts reject  D-1a2b3c4d           # 驳回：原样不动
mas drafts token                        # 拿人类令牌（agent 批不了自己的草稿）
mas drafts ticket D-1a2b3c4d --token <人类令牌>   # 签一张只管这一个草稿、用一次就作废的票据
mas drafts conflict                           # 查哪些草稿的文件在等待期间被改过
mas drafts approve D-1a2b3c4d --force           # 明知文件被改过，仍要写回
```

一次运行想改一个**已经存在**的文件时，它**不再直接覆盖**：
改动先进草稿，**原文件一个字节都不动**，草稿带一份**可读的 diff**，
你说「批准」才写回，你说「驳回」就**一个字都不改**。

```bash
$ mas drafts

工作区 ~/mas/artifacts：1 个草稿
  D-1a2b3c4d  pending  notes.txt  有改动
        理由：the loop proposed a change to an existing file
```

**新建文件照常直接写** —— 一个还不存在的文件，没有东西可以毁掉。
想回到旧行为，把配置里的 `edit_policy` 改成 `"overwrite"`（默认 `"draft"`）。

**机检读的是草稿里的新字节**，不是磁盘上的旧文件 —— 否则循环会陷入
「提改动 → 读旧文件 → 判不通过 → 再提改动」的死结，**永远闭不上**。
草稿和它改的文件**住在同一个工作区**（`.mas-drafts/`），文件夹被复制时
草稿跟着走 —— 丢掉的草稿，是一份**永远没法被人审阅**的改动。

### agent 经 MCP 提草稿（v0.7.73 起）：提议和批准分成两个动作

`mas drafts` 是**人**的那一半。MCP 上还有**一半给 agent**，
但两半**不是同一件事**：

```bash
# 人在自己的机器上拿令牌（一次就够）
mas drafts token
```

agent 侧的 MCP 工具：

| 工具 | 做什么 | 能不能改文件 |
|---|---|---|
| `mas_draft_stage` | **提**一份改动（带 diff 和理由） | **不能** —— 原文件一个字节都不动 |
| `mas_drafts` | 看有哪些草稿、看某一份的 diff | 不能 |
| `mas_draft_resolve` | 批准或驳回 | **要人类令牌** |
| `mas_files` | 索引工作区 | 只读 |
| `mas_preview` | 预览一个文件 | 只读 |

**agent 提的草稿，agent 自己批不了。** 令牌不对、空令牌、没令牌，
一律拒绝，而且**原文件不动**。
令牌的作用**不是保密，是分权** —— 提议的人不确认自己提的东西。

```bash
# agent 提了一个改动（文件没变）
mas_draft_stage {path: "notes.txt", content: "改过的正文", reason: "补一句结论"}

# agent 想自己批 —— 被拒
mas_draft_resolve {action: "approve", draft_id: "D-1a2b3c4d"}
-> {error: "human_token_required"}

# 人批 —— 才写回
mas_draft_resolve {action: "approve", draft_id: "D-1a2b3c4d", token: "<人类令牌>"}
```

详见 **[docs/drafts.md](docs/drafts.md)**（含与
[MOKI 资料库](https://github.com/JKZeng-cell/moki-library-for-dsh) 的分工对照：
MOKI 管**交互层**（`Alt+D`），本项目管**引擎层**（循环跑出来的东西），
**规则是同一条**）。

### 写二进制交付物（v0.7.70 起）：worker 怎么产出那个 PDF

内容级机检要读得进 PDF，**前提是有一个 PDF 存在**。写文件协议
（v0.7.15）原本只能带**文字**，所以交付物是 PDF 的任务**没法产出 PDF**。

现在写块可以带 **`encoding`** 属性：

```
<<<MAS:FILE path="out/report.pdf" encoding="base64">>>
JVBERi0xLjQK...
<<<MAS:END FILE>>>
```

引擎把块里的内容**解码成真正的二进制**再落盘，之后内容级机检就能读它。

| 情况 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| `encoding="base64"` | **解码成二进制**再写 |
| 不写 `encoding` | **按 UTF-8 文本写**（旧行为不变） |
| `encoding="rot13"` 等**不认识**的编码 | **拒绝**，并说明原因 |
| base64 **解不出来** | **拒绝**，并说明原因（不留半截文件） |

**base64 严格解码。** 宽松解码会把**不在字母表里的字符全丢掉**，
于是一段纯胡话被解成**一个空文件**、一声不吭 —— worker 要一份 PDF，
工作区里躺着一个**零字节的 PDF**。宁可拒绝。

**模板块不是请求。** 二进制模板里写着 `out/report.pdf`，看着像个真路径；
靠**路径**认不出模板（任务真可能就要写这个文件），所以改用**正文**认。

```bash
mas run --workspace ./my-project --goal "写一份调研报告" \
  --criteria 'file_exists:out/report.md' \
  --criteria 'file_contains:out/report.md::结论'
```

判定口径：**文件缺失 = 不通过**（不是「无法判定」）；路径越界 = 开跑前拒绝；
参数写漏 = 开跑前拒绝；路径合法但读不出结论 = `unjudged`。
单文件读取上限 8 MiB。**内容级机检读不出内容时判「不通过」**，理由同上。worker 用**写文件协议**（`<<<MAS:FILE path="...">>>` 围栏块）
把内容真的写进工作区，写入进账本可查。完整说明见 [`docs/file-checks.md`](docs/file-checks.md)。



**参数写漏了 = 标准作废，不是标准通过。** 规则缺参数时不可能判出任何结论，
所以引擎会在**开跑前**直接报错（退出码 1，不消耗任何 token），而不是让它恒真通过：

| 类型 | 必须提供 | 非法示例 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `contains` / `not_contains` | 非空字符串，或非空字符串数组 | `""`、`[]` |
| `min_chars` / `max_chars` / `lines_min` | 非负整数 | 缺失、`-1`、`"很多"` |
| `regex` | 能编译的正则 | `""`、`"([未闭合"` |
| `section` | 标题文本 | `""` |
| `json_keys` | 键名或非空键数组 | `[]`、缺失 |

**简写形式的坏参数同样快速失败。** `--criteria 'regex:'`、`--criteria 'min_chars:many'`
不会退回成纯描述——它们保留机检类型，然后被上面那张表拦下，退出码 1、零 token。
同一份标准，JSON 形式和简写形式待遇一致：写漏了就是写漏了，不会偷偷变成"交给模型判"。

**评审的判定要"读"出来，不是靠真值转换。** 模型如果回 `"pass": "false"`，
`bool("false")` 是 `True`——一条刚被判定为不通过的标准会被当成通过。引擎读的是
这个值的**含义**：`"false"` / `"0"` / `"no"` 是不通过，`"true"` / `"1"` / `"yes"` 是通过，
读不懂（`"maybe"`、空、缺失）就算**未判定**，绝不猜。

**类型名写错也不放过。** JSON 形式里写了一个不存在的类型（如
`{"check":{"type":"mystery"}}`），引擎同样在开跑前拒绝，并列出所有已知类型——
一个写错的类型名，如果放行，就会退化成"交给模型判"，模型说"看起来没问题"就闭合了。

只有**简写形式**里类型名本身不存在（`--criteria 'unknown_type:abc'`）才退回成纯描述——
那是压根没打算写机检，区别于"想写机检但写错了"。

### 简写写法（v0.4.2 起）

机检规则不必每次都写成 JSON。命令行可以直接用 `<类型>:<参数>`：

```bash
mas run --goal "写一个去重函数" \
  --criteria 'regex:(?s)def dedupe.*set' \
  --criteria 'min_chars:200' \
  --criteria 'contains:关键结论'
```

**一次写多条标准**，直接给 JSON 数组——数组里的每一条都带上自己的机检规则跑，
不会被当成一条纯文本描述（那样机检就一次都没跑过，闭合其实来自模型的"看起来没问题"）：

```bash
mas run --goal "写一份 v0.1.0 的发布说明" \
  --criteria '[{"id":"c1","desc":"包含版本号","check":{"type":"contains","arg":"v0.1.0"}},
               {"id":"c2","desc":"不少于 200 字","check":{"type":"min_chars","arg":200}}]'
```

简写与 JSON 形式完全等价，判定同样来自引擎的确定性检查器（账本里记为 `source: rule`）。
简写解析在引擎层生效，所以从 MCP、HTTP 或账本重放进来的标准也会被同样处理。
未知的类型前缀（例如 `写清楚就好`）仍然按普通描述处理，不会被误当成机检规则。
参数不是整数的数字类前缀（例如 `min_chars:很多`）同样退回普通描述——标准宁可没有机检，也不能声称自己能检查却做不到。

没有机检规则的标准会交给模型验证者判定；但**如果模型没给出判定，默认判不通过**（`unjudged`），不会因为一句「看起来可以」就放行。
`"required": false` 的标准**只记录、不阻塞闭合**：它有机检规则时照常跑机检，结果原样写进报告（过了是 `PASS`，没过是 `FAIL`），但不会让循环一直不闭合；它没有机检规则时由模型判定，判定结果同样只作记录。

**`required` 标志读的是含义，不是真值。** 写 `"required": "false"`（字符串）**确实**表示可选——
`bool("false")` 是 `True`，而这条标准一旦通过 JSON、MCP 或 shell 传进来，很容易就带上引号；
引擎读的是这个值的含义：`"false"` / `"0"` / `"no"` 是可选，`"true"` / `"1"` / `"yes"` 是必选，
读不懂（`"maybe"`、缺失、`null`）一律按**必选**处理——读不懂的标志绝不能悄悄把标准放宽。

> v0.4.2 起，验证者漏判某条标准时，引擎会在**同一轮内**就缺失的标准追问一次，
> 而不是重新生成整份交付物、白白消耗一整轮迭代。追问仍无答案才按 `unjudged` 记为不通过。

## 并行多智能体：让候选互相竞争

一个 worker 只会产出**一种**解法。v0.2 让多个 worker 带着**不同视角**并行产出候选，由引擎按机检结果选优：

```bash
# 单次任务临时加力，不改配置
mas run --goal "..." --criteria-file criteria.json \
  --parallel 3 --perspective thorough \
  --reviewers 3 --review-mode majority

mas init --wizard    # 交互式配置，第 7 题设并行数、第 8 题设评审数、第 11 题设回退链
```

| 旗标 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `--parallel N` | 并行候选数（N>1 时并发产出多个视角，引擎按机检通过数选优） |
| `--perspective` | 候选视角锚点：`direct` / `thorough` / `concise` / `structured` / `example_first` / `risk_first` |
| `--reviewers N` | 独立评审者数量（N>1 时启用对抗评审聚合） |
| `--review-mode` | 多评审聚合规则：`all`（全票通过）/ `majority`（过半）/ `any`（任一） |

或者直接改配置：

```json
{
  "orchestration": {
    "parallel_workers": 3,
    "reviewers": 3,
    "review_mode": "all"
  }
}
```

| 配置 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| `parallel_workers` | 并行产出的候选数。视角依次为 direct / thorough / concise / structured / example_first / risk_first，**不是同一段提示词的 N 次采样**。 |
| `reviewers` | 独立验证者数量。视角依次为 strict / skeptic / completeness / reader。 |
| `review_mode` | `all` 一票否决（全通过才算通过）/ `majority` 多数通过 / `any` 任一通过。 |

**选优规则是确定性的**：先看机检通过项数，再看产物体积，最后按下标定序。同一份配置跑两次，选中的一定是同一个候选 —— 这让回放可信。

**机检永远压过模型判断**：有 `check` 的标准由规则决定，只有没有机检的标准才交给评审共识。评审说「通过」不能覆盖规则说「不通过」。

**默认就是 v0.1 的行为**：`parallel_workers: 1`、`reviewers: 1` 时，路径与 v0.1 完全一致。

## 远程接入：HTTP + SSE

stdio 传输给本地 Agent 用；HTTP/SSE 传输让运行时能被远程客户端、浏览器面板或 CI 任务访问：

```bash
mas http --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765
```

| 路由 | 方法 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/health` | GET | 存活检查 + 版本 |
| `/tools` | GET | 工具清单 |
| `/call` | POST | 调用任一工具，JSON 进 JSON 出 |
| `/events` | GET | SSE 事件流，实时推送账本增长 |

```bash
# 免鉴权（仅限本机访问）
curl http://127.0.0.1:8765/health
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8765/call \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tool":"mas_run","arguments":{"goal":"写一份发布说明","criteria":[]}}'
curl -N http://127.0.0.1:8765/events
```

### 鉴权（对外暴露时必做）

`/call` 能执行任务、读账本，`/events` 能持续推送账本内容 —— 所以从 **v0.4.8** 起，HTTP 传输**内置鉴权**：

```bash
export MAS_HTTP_TOKEN=$(python -c "import secrets;print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))")
mas http --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8765
```

设了 `MAS_HTTP_TOKEN` 之后，除 `/health` 外的所有路由都需要令牌：

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $MAS_HTTP_TOKEN" http://127.0.0.1:8765/tools
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8765/call \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $MAS_HTTP_TOKEN" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tool":"mas_status","arguments":{}}'
```

也可以用 `X-MAS-Token: <token>` 请求头代替 `Authorization`。

**fail-closed**：绑定到非本机地址（`0.0.0.0` / 局域网 IP）却**没有**令牌时，服务器**拒绝启动**（退出码 `2`）—— 环境变量写错不应该变成公网裸奔。开启鉴权后 CORS 也不再回 `*`，而是钉到 `http://127.0.0.1`，避免任意网页跨站调用。


### 常驻部署实战（服务 + TLS 反代）

真正要长期给手机 / 其它设备用，推荐这个组合 —— **服务只绑本机，对外只暴露 TLS 入口**：

```bash
# 1. 令牌落在文件里，不进版本库、不进启动脚本
python -c "import secrets,pathlib;pathlib.Path.home().joinpath('.mas/http_token.txt').write_text(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))"

# 2. 服务常驻（示例：Linux systemd / Windows 启动文件夹 / macOS launchd 均可）
export MAS_HTTP_TOKEN=$(cat ~/.mas/http_token.txt)
mas http --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8768

# 3. 只把 TLS 入口反代出去（tailnet 内；--https 需要 tailscale serve 权限）
tailscale serve --bg --https=8768 http://127.0.0.1:8768
```

手机 / 其它设备访问 `https://<your-host>:<port>/tools`，带上 `Authorization: Bearer <令牌>`。

要点：

- 服务绑 `127.0.0.1` + TLS 反代，比直接 `--host 0.0.0.0` 安全得多（不暴露在局域网，也由反代统一处理 TLS）。
- 令牌与启动脚本**分离**：脚本里不写明文，令牌文件缺失就报错退出，绝不退化成无鉴权启动。
- `tailscale serve` 默认是 **tailnet only**；`funnel` 会暴露到公网，属于扩大暴露范围，请自行评估后再开。
- 停用：`tailscale serve --https=8768 off`。

## 四道止损机制

1. **迭代预算**：`budget.max_iterations`，超出即 `budget_exhausted`。
2. **墙钟预算**：`budget.deadline_sec`。
3. **token 预算**：`budget.max_tokens`。
4. **停滞检测**：连续多轮产出**完全相同**的产物（默认 3 次，`stagnation_limit`）→ 判定卡死，**升级人工工单**，不再空转。

升级出来的工单带齐上下文（目标、验收标准、最后一版产物、失败原因、迭代历史），人工一句话就能接着跑：

```bash
mas tickets
mas resume T-20261111-085346-4396 --note "按用户口径重写结论段"
```

## 接入你自己的模型

运行时只用标准库，HTTP 走 `urllib`，所以任何 OpenAI 兼容端点都能接。

```bash
# Kimi / Moonshot
mas init --provider openai_compat --model kimi-k2 --base-url https://api.moonshot.cn/v1
export MAS_API_KEY=sk-...

# Claude
mas init --provider anthropic --model claude-sonnet-4-5
export MAS_API_KEY=sk-ant-...

# GPT / Grok / DeepSeek / Qwen / 本地 vLLM 等，OpenAI 兼容即可
mas init --provider openai_compat --model gpt-4o-mini --base-url https://api.openai.com/v1
```

适配器自带三种容错，兼容绝大多数「OpenAI 兼容」网关：

- 网关不支持 `response_format` 时自动降级重试一次，并从回答正文里抽取 JSON；
- 网关用 SSE 事件流回答（很多中转站和本地桥接都是这样）时自动折叠成标准 chat 结构；
- 网关用 Responses 事件流回答（Codex 桥接、OpenMausBot 这类运行时）时同样折叠；
- 网关只认 `input` 不认 `messages` 时也能工作 —— 请求同时带两份，二选一被读取；
- 回答是内容块数组而不是字符串时，自动拼成纯文本；
- usage 字段名在 `prompt_tokens` / `input_tokens` 两套之间自动归一，缺 `total_tokens` 时回填；
- 模型在正文前吐 `<think>` 思维链时自动剥离，思维链不会进入交付物、判定和账本。

装完之后跑一次握手，看你的端点到底说哪种方言：

```bash
mas doctor
# [OK  ] endpoint       端点可用，协议方言 = openai-responses-events
```

也可以完全用环境变量，不改配置文件：

```bash
export MAS_PROVIDER=openai_compat MAS_MODEL=your-model MAS_BASE_URL=https://... MAS_API_KEY=...
```

## 接入 DeepSeek Harness（可选）

仓库里带了一个 **DSH 插件**（`integrations/dsh-openloop-mas`）：它不重写闭环逻辑，
而是通过 **MCP** 调用本地运行时，因此 DSH 对话里的判定与账本，和 Codex / Claude Code
客户端看到的是**同一份事实**。

```powershell
# 可选开关：默认关闭，主线安装仍然零依赖（纯 Python，不需要 Node / DSH / npm）
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1 -InstallDshPlugin
```

装好后 DSH 里多出 6 个工具：`mas_run`、`mas_status`、`mas_ledger`、`mas_tickets`、
`mas_report`、`mas_doctor`。

细节、配置项、实测证据与边界见 **[docs/dsh-integration.md](docs/dsh-integration.md)**。

### 让 DSH 真的能说话：`mas relay`

装上插件不等于模型能用。DSH 的 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 适配器**坚持要一个 API key**，
而私有端点常常**不要 key**（甚至会因为占位 key 直接 `401`）——这是协议契约和
端点契约打架。`mas relay` 插在中间：丢弃客户端的 `Authorization`，按需换成上游真 key。

```powershell
# 一键生成能跑的 DSH profile（写配置 + 装插件 + 打印命令）
python tools/setup_dsh_bridge.py --profile masbridge --relay-port 8766

# 终端 1
mas relay --upstream http://127.0.0.1:16024 --port 8766

# 终端 2：pi-ai 坚持要 key，给个占位值即可（relay 会丢弃它）
$env:MAS_BRIDGE_API_KEY = "placeholder"
dsh --profile masbridge headless "用 mas_run 跑一个闭环：目标是写一份发布说明，验收标准用 file_exists 要求 out/report.md 存在"
```

> **`headless` 是 profile 名，不是子命令。** 正确形态是 `dsh --profile <name> headless "<task>"`。

中继的两种鉴权模式、安全边界、已验证/未验证清单见 **[docs/relay.md](docs/relay.md)**。

### 同宿主并列插件：MOKI 资料库

[MOKI](https://github.com/JKZeng-cell/moki-library-for-dsh)（`dsh-moki-library`）是
**另一个项目**，别和 OpenMausBot 混：它给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个**本地资源管理器**——
文件/网页链接统一整理、多格式预览、选区 `Alt+D` 唤起 AI 对话、**修改先进草稿、
用户确认后才写回原文件**。

分工很清楚：**MOKI 负责把资料整理成可交付的产物，MAS 负责判定这份产物到底过不过。**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "dsh-moki-library@file:<绝对路径>/dsh-moki-library-0.1.73.tgz" --allow-build=sharp
dsh plugin --profile web add "dsh-openloop-mas@file:<绝对路径>/dsh-openloop-mas-0.7.16.tgz"
```

> MOKI 需要 **DSH >= 0.2.2-rc.1**、**Node >= 22.19**，且是 **web-platform 插件**——
> 在 CLI / headless profile 里会一直 pending（宿主形态不对，不是装坏了）。

## 随包附带的 Agent Skill

| Skill | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `mas-loop` | 跑闭环任务、写验收标准、读账本与工单 |
| `mas-review` | 多视角对抗式审查（执行者 / 验证者 / 复盘者分离） |
| `mas-scaffold` | 给新项目搭团队模板与 CI 门禁 |

安装器会把它们装进本机能找到的所有 skill 目录（`~/.codex/skills`、`~/.claude/skills`、`~/.agents/skills`、`~/.gemini/skills`）。

> Skill 的**唯一真源是 `mas/skills/`**——它随 wheel 一起分发，所以 `pip install` 装出来的 skill
> 和从源码装出来的 skill 逐字节相同，不存在两份副本各自漂移的问题。

卸载：

```bash
mas uninstall       # 移除 skills 与 MCP 注册（保留 ~/.mas 里的账本与配置）
pip uninstall openloop-mas
```

---

## 目录结构

```
openloop-mas/
├─ mas/                 运行时（纯标准库）
│  ├─ engine.py         闭环引擎：预算、停滞判定、闭合/升级
│  ├─ orchestration.py  并行候选、对抗评审聚合、后端故障转移
│  ├─ providers.py      mock / OpenAI 兼容 / Anthropic 适配
│  ├─ ledger.py         append-only 账本
│  ├─ tickets.py        人工升级工单
│  ├─ mcp_server.py     MCP stdio 服务
│  ├─ http_server.py    MCP over HTTP + SSE（远程接入）
│  ├─ report.py         复盘报告、回放轨迹、账本导出
│  ├─ setup.py          交互式向导 + 真实闭环自检
│  ├─ bench.py          离线基准测试
│  ├─ cli.py            命令行
│  ├─ drafts.py         草稿层：改动先进草稿，人确认后才写回
│  ├─ doctor.py         安装自检
│  ├─ demo.py           三个离线场景
│  └─ teams/            团队模板（default / review / content）
│  └─ skills/           Agent Skill 包（唯一真源，随 wheel 一起分发）
├─ integrations/        DSH 插件（DeepSeek Harness 集成）
├─ tests/               离线测试
├─ install.ps1          Windows 一键安装
├─ install.sh           macOS / Linux 一键安装
└─ docs/                架构、方法论、MCP、定位说明
```

## 命令速查

```bash
mas install       # 装 skills + 注册 MCP 服务器
mas sync          # 把已安装的 skills 同步回包内版本（修复漂移）
mas uninstall     # 移除 skills + MCP 注册（保留账本）
mas init          # 生成/更新配置
mas init --wizard # 交互式向导，一步步配好
mas run           # 跑一个闭环任务
mas demo          # 离线演示三个闭环场景
mas verify        # 跑一次真实闭环自检
mas bench         # 离线基准测试
mas status        # 本机状态
mas ledger        # 闭环账本
mas ledger --undone   # 只看被撤销过的那几条批准
mas undos        # 哪些批准被撤回了：配对 + 改了多少行
mas report        # 闭环复盘报告（Markdown）
mas replay        # 回放运行轨迹
mas export        # 导出账本为 Markdown 表格
mas tickets       # 人工工单
mas resume ID     # 带人工意见继续
mas teams         # 团队模板
mas doctor        # 安装自检
mas selftest      # 隔失门禁：重复打磈易偶发的路径（离线）
mas clean --selftest-ledger   # 清理旧版自检留下的账本污染（先 --dry-run 看）
mas files        # 索引工作区：每个文件是什么格式、能读出什么
mas preview FILE # 预览一个文件（PDF / Word / 文本…）
mas drafts       # 待确认的草稿：list / show / approve / reject / undo / token / ticket / conflict
mas drafts token # 拿人类令牌：agent 提的草稿，agent 自己批不了
mas drafts ticket D-ID --token <令牌>  # 签一张只管一个草稿、用一次就作废、15 分钟过期的票据
mas serve         # 以 MCP stdio 服务运行
mas http          # 以 HTTP + SSE 运行（远程接入；对外部署请设 MAS_HTTP_TOKEN）
mas relay         # OpenAI 兼容中继：给「非要 API Key」的客户端用（默认 127.0.0.1:8766）
```

`mas run` 退出码：`0` = 闭合，`2` = 未闭合（升级或预算耗尽）。CI 里可以直接当门禁用。

---

## 开发与测试

```bash
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v   # 213 个离线测试，不需要网络
python -m mas demo                        # 三个闭环场景
python -m mas bench                       # 离线基准测试
python -m mas verify                      # 真实闭环自检
python -m mas selftest --iterations 120     # 隔失门禁（会拒绝绝经不可能的路径）
```
