evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-lead-mode A Lead mode for DSH: the model judges, delegates, and reports the conclusion; members do the hands-on work, gather the facts, and run acceptance. The runtime ships the tools; this plugin ships the method. [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-lead-mode?color=4D6BFE)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-lead-mode) [![dsh version](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-%3E%3D0.2.2--rc.3-4D6BFE)](https://github.com/xiebaiyuan/dsh-lead-mode/blob/main/package.json) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-3DA639)](https://github.com/xiebaiyuan/dsh-lead-mode/blob/main/LICENSE) [![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-45%20passing-3DA639)](https://github.com/xiebaiyuan/dsh-lead-mode/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-lead-mode)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-lead-mode) [![CI](https://github.com/xiebaiyuan/dsh-lead-mode/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/xiebaiyuan/dsh-lead-mode/actions/workflows/ci.yml) `dsh plugin --profile add dsh-lead-mode` [中文](README.zh-CN.md) | English
## What this is A Lead mode plugin for DSH (DeepSeek Harness). Version 0.2.12, requires host (the program running dsh) >= 0.2.2-rc.3, MIT licensed. It covers the method layer. The official Agent Teams runtime hands you tools: the older generation has `spawn_teammate`, `send_message`, `team_task_*`; the newer one builds members with `subagent`, keeps `send_message` and `team_task_*`, and gets completion notices from the runtime instead of `wait_agent` polling. When to delegate, to whom, how to wait, how to review, how to merge several streams — none of that comes with the runtime. Installing adds four things: two presets (`Lead · PTC`, `Lead · Create`), two skills (`lead-mode`, `team-digest`), one `/lead-mode` command, and two opening reminders. Not a single official preset is modified, and host behavior is untouched. It does not replace the official Team mode. When Team is off it will not pretend it can delegate — it stops and hands you the next step. ## Why it is worth it Agent Teams is off by default. Official Team tools are not in official presets; a session switch controls them, and on older hosts you also install a profile package. When those tools are missing there are two typical reactions: do everything serially in one context, or use `subagent` as a stand-in for a member. Both are wrong, and neither the user nor the model learns which piece was missing. This plugin does three things: 1. Two presets that change only the persona. Every other field is copied line by line from the official `ptc` (24 lines) and `cordis` (23 lines), so no capability is lost. 2. Two skills that turn splitting work, delegating, running a shared task board, reviewing, and merging into a routine you can actually follow. 3. One self-check command and two reminders, so the model stops when Team is not ready and writes the next step as a command you can paste or a specific switch to flip. The vision: > Let your AI team pin down your requirements; the Lead oversees the full split and execution and gets 200% out of the model. 200% is the target, not a measured number. Three invariants: 1. The method outlives the tools. Tools get renamed, hosts move on, the working method stays. Supporting two generations of Agent Teams is the first stress test of that claim. 2. Deliverables land in files. Progress logs, closing messages, and team summaries live on disk and still read fine a week later. 3. Missing pieces come with a next step. Never silence, never a workaround. ## Install Two steps. **One — install the plugin.** ```bash dsh plugin --profile add dsh-lead-mode ``` **Two — turn on the Team runtime.** On newer hosts (0.2.2-rc.3 and up), enable "Agent team collaboration" in the Models & Reasoning Level menu; older hosts call that switch "Use agent team". The older-generation runtime has no such switch — install the official profile package instead, matching the version to what `dsh --version` prints: ```bash dsh plugin --profile add @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile@0.2.2-rc.1 ``` Restart dsh, then pick `Lead · PTC` or `Lead · Create` in the preset list of a new session and run `/lead-mode` to see the dependency status. If it returns success, you are set. You can skip the presets entirely: any session accepts `/skill lead-mode` or `/skill team-digest`. What you lose is the short pointer in the persona; the method loads either way. ## Pick a preset Lead changes method, not capability, so each preset mirrors an official one: | Preset | Lines | Base | Difference | |---|---|---|---| | `lead-ptc` | 24 | official `ptc`, field by field | persona only | | `lead-cordis` | 23 | official `cordis` (Create), field by field | persona, plus `skill-filesystem` without `customSkillDirs` | **Pick `lead-ptc`** when the session writes programs, runs commands, and edits files in bulk. That is the PTC shape: only `run_code` takes direct calls, everything else is `tools.xxx()` inside a program. A Lead delegating, creating tasks, and sending messages follows that style. **Pick `lead-cordis`** when tools are called directly, with `tool-cordis` available — sessions that modify DSH itself or call tools straight from the model. That is what "Create" means on this host. `customSkillDirs` is omitted on purpose: the official expression resolves `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` relative to the patch file, and this package cannot resolve the host package from there, so copying it line for line throws at load time. The cost is that the `dsh-doc` skill is not in `lead-cordis`'s filesystem skill directories. Both presets are copied from the web-app presets, so they only fit desktop and Web profiles. Headless profiles lack those tool rows — do not switch a Lead preset on one. ## How it delegates ![Mechanism: a request reaches the Lead, the Lead splits and delegates, members work and report on a shared task board, an independent member runs acceptance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiebaiyuan/dsh-lead-mode/main/assets/diagram-en.svg) Four beats: a request arrives, the Lead splits and delegates, members work and report on a shared task board, and the fourth beat is acceptance. A member who did none of the work runs the checks, and the Lead decides from its evidence. The dashed line is the loop back when acceptance fails. **Split.** The Lead does three things only: judge, delegate, and report the conclusion. What it touches is the control plane — `list_subagent_models` to pick models, `list_agents` for the roster, `team_task_*` for the board, `send_message` to nudge — and calling those is itself the delegating. It stays out of the working plane: code, files, logs, CI, packages all go to members, investigation and acceptance alike, and acceptance goes to a member who did none of the work. When this round has only the implementer, it spawns a separate read-only member to re-run, rather than doing it itself. If it cannot delegate, it stops and asks you to turn Team on — it does not finish the job alone and does not put `subagent` in a member's seat. Before delegating it picks provider/model pairs from what `list_subagent_models` returns, reasoning effort included. No invented ids. A single-entry list means the host authorized nothing else, so members inherit the Lead's route. **Shared task board and progress logs.** Each member gets its own context. Whether to use a board is the Lead's call: build one when there are several members and they have to wait on each other or message each other; a job one member finishes in one round is delegated directly. With a board, the Lead creates tasks on `team_task_*` with goal and acceptance criteria spelled out; members claim them and work. Every member's first step is `.scratch//worklog-.md` (`` names this round of work; `worklog-*.md` is the progress log), append-only, with the final round written before wrapping up. Write scopes (each member only touches its own files) are split by file or directory; when they overlap, task dependencies set the order. Who owns what, and who is stuck, is on the board — not in the chat log. **Acceptance.** The Lead does not wait. It ends its turn after delegating; a member's completion notice starts the next round. Nudging goes through `send_message`, never `wait_agent` polling. This holds across both generations: older `send_message` takes `target`, newer takes `agent`. Reports must carry evidence: `path:line`, a command that can be pasted, a progress log section name, or `session-#seq`. A finding only counts once an independent member has re-run it; the Lead reads that evidence before the final answer. ## What it looks like ![Repository social preview: icon on the left, title and one-line positioning on the right](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiebaiyuan/dsh-lead-mode/main/assets/social-preview.png) The repo's social preview, 1280×630: icon on the left, title and a one-line positioning statement on the right. ![Lead · PTC and Lead · Create in the preset picker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiebaiyuan/dsh-lead-mode/main/assets/screenshots/preset-picker.png) The preset picker in a new session. The two entries are `Lead · PTC` and `Lead · Create`. ![The /lead-mode entry in the slash panel: command and skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiebaiyuan/dsh-lead-mode/main/assets/screenshots/lead-mode-command-panel.png) Typing `/lead-mode` in a session: the slash panel offers the command and the skill. What it prints on a 0.2.7 install running on host 0.2.2-rc.5: ```text Team 运行时：已挂载（新一代，teammate 走 subagent） lead-ptc 预置：已注册 lead-cordis 预置：已注册 依赖齐了。切到 lead-ptc 或 lead-cordis 就能派活。 Team 开关是会话级的：模型与推理等级菜单里打开「开启智能体团队协作」（旧宿主叫「使用智能体团队」）。 ``` ## Skills and task tools | Capability | Entry point | What you do | |---|---|---| | Lead presets | `Lead · PTC` or `Lead · Create` in the preset picker | Pick one | | Lead method skill | `/skill lead-mode`, also self-loaded by the model | Nothing | | Team summary skill | `/skill team-digest`, loaded at the model's discretion before wrapping up | Nothing | | Dependency self-check | `/lead-mode` | Run it when dependencies look off | | Two opening reminders | automatic | Nothing | `lead-mode` covers: agreeing on the goal before starting; reading the tool list to tell which generation you are on; delegating with self-contained prompts; keeping write scopes disjoint (each member only touches its own files); the list/get/claim/complete flow on shared tasks; why not to wait on a member; where member models come from; the four-step handoff as context grows; setting the bar high with pass criteria you can actually check, without patching a rework yourself (two failed retries and you change the member, cut scope, or stop and ask — cutting scope means dropping what cannot be done and saying what was dropped, never lowering the bar); handing the final verification to an independent member; and, when a task keeps coming back wrong and the three conditions hold, escalating once to a single plan-only member on the same model as the Lead (a last resort, never the default). `team-digest` merges the whole team's wrap-up into `reports/-.md` with six blocks: conclusion / who did what / acceptance evidence / deviations and unverified claims / what did not work and the decisions / open items and next steps. It is written only when this round of work had two or more members, or spanned two or more rounds. Delegation uses three groups of tools: `subagent` / `subagent_fork` to create members, `send_message` to continue and nudge, and `team_task_create` / `team_task_get` / `team_task_list` / `team_task_update` for shared tasks. The older generation maps to `spawn_teammate` and `send_message({ target })` — same rules, different parameter names. Both presets share one persona, 448 characters, injected into the system prompt every turn; details load from the skills on demand and cost no standing context. Additive only, nothing modified. If a same-named skill or command already exists, the host takes first-come and this plugin steps aside. ## Compatibility and limits | Item | Detail | |---|---| | Host | `>=0.2.2-rc.3` (`engines.dsh`), Node `>=20` | | Agent Teams | Both generations supported; judged by the tool list, not by version number | | Preset shape | Both presets are copied from the web-app presets and only fit desktop or Web profiles | | Subagent models | The host's Subagent → Model selection is off by default; while off, explicit provider/model is rejected and members inherit the Lead's route. Changes apply to new sessions only | | Interrupting members | Newer hosts ship `interrupt_agent` off (`interrupt: false`); ask the user to enable it before a hard interrupt | | Host footprint | `cordis.patch.yml` is three `insert` rows in total: this plugin and its two presets. No tools registered, no agent lifecycle hooks, no request interception; uninstalling reclaims it all | | Missing services | If `skills`, `commands`, or `agentTeams` is absent, the plugin still mounts, logs a warning, and drops that part of the toolset | | Never opens Team for you | Installing the older profile package or flipping the newer session switch is always an explicit user action | A field-by-field comparison of the two generations is in [docs/agent-teams.md](https://github.com/xiebaiyuan/dsh-lead-mode/blob/main/docs/agent-teams.md); what goes wrong when versions are mismatched is in [docs/why.md](https://github.com/xiebaiyuan/dsh-lead-mode/blob/main/docs/why.md). ## Docs | Looking for | Where | |---|---| | Motivation, problem breakdown, boundaries | [docs/why.md](https://github.com/xiebaiyuan/dsh-lead-mode/blob/main/docs/why.md) | | Install, enabling Team, usage, capability detail, dependency table | [docs/usage.md](https://github.com/xiebaiyuan/dsh-lead-mode/blob/main/docs/usage.md) | | Two generations of Agent Teams, side by side | [docs/agent-teams.md](https://github.com/xiebaiyuan/dsh-lead-mode/blob/main/docs/agent-teams.md) | | Design tradeoffs: staying out of the official way, preset differences | [docs/design.md](https://github.com/xiebaiyuan/dsh-lead-mode/blob/main/docs/design.md) | | Layout, development, tests, releases | [docs/development.md](https://github.com/xiebaiyuan/dsh-lead-mode/blob/main/docs/development.md) | | The Lead method itself | [skills/lead-mode/SKILL.md](https://github.com/xiebaiyuan/dsh-lead-mode/blob/main/skills/lead-mode/SKILL.md) | | Team summary rules | [skills/team-digest/SKILL.md](https://github.com/xiebaiyuan/dsh-lead-mode/blob/main/skills/team-digest/SKILL.md) | | Vocabulary | [GLOSSARY.md](https://github.com/xiebaiyuan/dsh-lead-mode/blob/main/GLOSSARY.md) | | Change history | [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/xiebaiyuan/dsh-lead-mode/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) | | Sample team summaries | [reports/](https://github.com/xiebaiyuan/dsh-lead-mode/tree/main/reports) | `docs/` is not shipped in the npm package, so those pages exist on GitHub only; every link is absolute, which also keeps them clickable from the npm page. ## Friendly link: dsh-context This plugin only covers Lead mode. Visualizing the whole team's state and traffic is [dsh-context](https://github.com/bowenliang123/dsh-context)'s job — a separate project. | Item | Value | |---|---| | Repo | https://github.com/bowenliang123/dsh-context | | Author | bowenliang123 | | License | Apache-2.0 | | Install | `dsh plugin --profile add dsh-context` | It does not install with this plugin and is not a dependency of it. The fleet page exists only when it is installed. Once installed, every session gains a Fleet tab (to the right of Context), and the Context panel in the right rail shows the same card with five sections: | Section | What you see | |---|---| | Overview | Member status, live context, estimated spend, task progress | | Agent Network | The current agent, its parent, and all subagents — one card each | | Fleet Members | Each member's role, model, latest reply, runtime, step count, open task count | | Tasks | Team tasks and subagent delegations together, grouped by owner, with blocked-by chains | | Agent Comms | Who said what to whom: team messages, mailbox deliveries, runtime settlement notices | ## License MIT. Full text in [LICENSE](https://github.com/xiebaiyuan/dsh-lead-mode/blob/main/LICENSE).

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-xwide-color-tags

给 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏的每个会话打颜色标签：一眼分出「这条在跟什么活」。两条入口——右键会话的菜单色板，和会话行左端的小圆点弹板。选中后该会话行左侧出现同色竖条、标题染同色。

纯前端插件，零运行时依赖，只写浏览器 `localStorage`，不碰宿主任何配置文件。

## 用法

### 1. 右键会话 → 「会话颜色」色板

- **4 个预设色**：荧光黄 `#ffc300`、荧光绿 `#2ecc71`、荧光青 `#00c8ff`、荧光粉 `#ff63c5`。
- **彩虹块**：打开自绘取色面板（见第 4 条）。
- **✕ 清除**：只在当前会话已上色时出现，清掉这个会话的颜色。
- 色块样式取自 `dsh-xwide-annotation` 的「批注配色」：32×32、圆角 9px、选中加白色 2px 描边；彩虹块同款 conic 渐变。

### 2. 会话行左端的小圆点

- 已上色的会话行左端有一枚 10px 小圆点，颜色＝该会话的颜色。
- **点圆点**开弹板（同一排色块）；圆点带白色描边＝当前正在用的颜色。
- 弹板是浮动层，带 `data-context-menu-trigger="1"`，不会被宿主的全局按钮样式扫描改写。

### 3. 右键＝取消（弹板里一套统一机制）

| 你在弹板里按右键的位置 | 发生什么 |
|---|---|
| 预设色块 / 彩虹块 | 取消这个会话的颜色，并收板 |
| 「我的颜色」里的自定义色块 | 删掉这一个自定义色（面板原地重画，当场少一格），会话颜色不动 |
| 弹板空白处 / ✕ 按钮 | 收板（✕ 同时清掉会话颜色） |

每个块的悬停提示都写着它这一按会干什么，形如 `#ff63c5（右键＝删除这个自定义色）`、`荧光黄（右键＝取消颜色）`。

### 4. 彩虹块＝自绘 HSV 取色面板

不用系统取色盘（样式不可控、也不可调明度饱和度），插件自绘：

- 左边一块 **明度/饱和度方格**，右边一条 **色相条**，下方一条 **明度滑条**，外加当前色预览。
- **取色**＝把当前颜色加进「我的颜色」并立即应用到这个会话；**确定**＝只入「我的颜色」；**取消**＝什么都不写。
- 入队的颜色**按 hex 去重**（同色不重复占位），**最多保留最近 8 个**，超出的从队头挤掉。

### 5. 恢复默认

「我的颜色」非空时，弹板末尾出现 **「恢复默认」** 按钮：点一下清空整排自定义色，弹板原地重画。

- 它**不动会话颜色**——那是你正在用的标记，清它会话颜色请用 ✕。
- 没有二次确认（清空不可撤销），要留色请先别按。

## 存储

只写浏览器 localStorage，键名前缀 `xwcolor.`：

| 键 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `xwcolor.map` | `{ sessionId: "#rrggbb" }` 会话 → 颜色 |
| `xwcolor.customs` | 「我的颜色」列表（最近 8 个） |
| `xwcolor.probe` | 自检记录：会话行选择器命中情况（见下） |

## 已知限制（读数说话，不粉饰）

- **端口换＝存储换。** 桌面端 GUI 的本地端口每次重启都会变，而浏览器存储是按 origin（含端口）分家的。实测本机连换三次端口后，`xwcolor.*` 落在旧 origin 里读不到，表现就是「颜色和自定义色像回到了默认」。这是宿主的 origin 行为，**插件侧目前没有做迁移**。
- **会话行 DOM 形状未实盘验证。** 开发时真机界面带鉴权（返回 401），无头浏览器读不到登录后的页面；上色效果、菜单项在页面上的呈现，全部证据来自无头浏览器的真 DOM 断言，**没在真人界面上逐条验收过**。
- **清空自定义色不可撤销**，且没有「只删这一个之外的全部」这类批量选择。

## 与 Codex UI 的关系

已核对 `@michengai/dsh-codex-ui` 2.3.0：它的全局按钮改样式扫描排除 `[data-context-menu-trigger]`、`[aria-haspopup="menu"]`、`[data-row-key]`。本插件的色块一律带 `data-context-menu-trigger="1"` + `role="menuitem"`，因此落在它的排除名单里，不被改样式；槽位用它没有占的 `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item`（order 900，在「归档」之前、Codex UI 未读项 order 150 之后）。

## 自检

插件启动时会把候选选择器的命中数与前 3 个 key 样本写进 `localStorage["xwcolor.probe"]`，形如：

```json
{ "ts": 1730000000000, "found": { "[data-row-key]": { "count": 12, "sampleKeys": ["session-abc", "..."] } } }
```

- 哪个选择器 `count > 0` 且 `sampleKeys` 长得像 sessionId → 上色就会生效。
- 全是 `count: 0` 或 `(nokey)` → 菜单能选色、存色，但行上不上色；把这段读数发出来即可定位真实选择器。

## 安装 / 卸载

- 安装：`npm i dsh-xwide-color-tags`，或在 profile 的 `local-plugins\` 下放本目录并在 `cordis.patch.yml` 加装载行。
- 卸载：删除本目录 + 移除 profile 里的装载行与 junction；`xwcolor.*` 三个键留在 localStorage，不留残留文件。

## 版本

- **0.1.1**：会话行左端小圆点＋浮动弹板；右键统一成「取消／删除」机制；彩虹块换成自绘 HSV 取色面板（明度饱和度可调）；自定义色去重＋封顶 8；新增「恢复默认」一键清空我的颜色。
- **0.1.0**：右键会话菜单色板（4 预设 + 彩虹 + ✕），会话行上色。

MIT License。

The exact npm metadata has no gitHead, so published package to fixed-source mapping is not established; state lives in browser localStorage. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

# 续笔 · dsh-composer-quill

在 DSH 的输入框里，把接下来想说的话提前写出来。

一个回合刚结束，它已经猜到你下一句要问什么；你打字打到一半，它把后半句接上。想换个说法就换个候选，不想要就忽略。

它是 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的插件，完全在本机运行：请求走你已经在 DSH 里配置好的模型路由，没有第三方服务器。

## 四种建议

### 下一句

回合刚结束时，它给几条「下一句」，左右键可以换。切回一个聊过的会话时也会给。

![下一句：输入框为空时给出候选，提示条上标着第几条](docs/assets/real-next.png)

### 补写

打字停一下就出补写。随着你继续打字，它会一点点收窄，最后只剩尾巴那几字。

![补写：深色是已输入的内容，浅色是接上的后半句](docs/assets/real-tail.png)

### 改写

草稿里有错字、标点乱、或者一句话塞了好几件事，它会给一整段整理过的版本，采用就是整段替换。

![改写：草稿里的错字和断句被整理成完整的一句，提示条上是改写后的版本](docs/assets/real-rewrite.png)

### 历史

以前说过类似的话时，它直接从你的历史输入里取，不花模型调用，反应是毫秒级的。

![历史：打到一半时，后面接上你以前说过的原话](docs/assets/real-history.png)


这几件事都不会打断你：`Esc` 关掉之后同一份草稿不会再弹回来；请求进行中不会清空重来，上一条建议留在屏幕上标一个「· 补写中…」；组字期间不打断输入，也不会把组字内容当成草稿。

## 按键

`Tab` 采用当前建议；左右方向键切换候选（只有「下一句」有多条时）；`Esc` 关掉；`Ctrl+Shift+Space` 手动要一条，「仅手动」模式下这是唯一入口。

## 安装

需要 DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`（不匹配的宿主会在安装阶段被拦下），并且已经在 DSH 里配好一个可用的模型。插件不改装模型，只借用你现有的路由；没配模型时不会有任何建议。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-composer-quill                # 从 npm 装
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:yugyq/dsh-composer-quill   # 或从仓库装
```

界面里也可以：**设置 → 插件 → 添加插件**，输入框填 `dsh-composer-quill`。本地开发时填目录路径，`dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-composer-quill`。

装完要重启 DSH，不是刷新页面：客户端代码在启动时按版本固定，刷新只会拿到旧的。想知道在跑哪一版，看日志里的 `build` 字段。

这是第三方插件，与 DeepSeek 官方没有隶属关系。遇到问题请开 [issue](https://github.com/yugyq/dsh-composer-quill/issues)，附上日志里相关的那几行。

## 设置

**设置 → 通用 → 续笔**。配置存在浏览器的 `localStorage` 里，不联网。

- **启用**（默认开）：总开关
- **模式**（自动）：「仅手动」时只在按快捷键时请求
- **语言**（跟随系统）：跟随系统 / 中文 / English。指定后强制，草稿语言不同会整段翻译
- **停顿**（120 ms）：打字后多久发请求，范围 80–2000
- **超时**（20000 ms）：单次请求上限，范围 3000–60000
- **采纳反馈**（自动）：`Tab` 采纳、`Esc` 忽略、没采纳就发送都计入，用来重排「下一句」候选

## 隐私

只在本机。补全请求走 DSH 已配置的模型路由，诊断日志写在 `~/.dsh/composer-quill.log`。

上下文出机器前会遮蔽凭据，九类形状会被替换成 `[redacted …]`：私钥块、AWS `AKIA…`、GitHub `ghp_` / `github_pat_`、OpenAI `sk-…`、Stripe、Slack `xox…`、JWT、`Bearer …`。正在编辑的草稿不遮蔽，这是刻意的——建议由「草稿 + 尾巴」拼成，遮蔽会把 `[redacted]` 写进你要发的消息。

接口有鉴权：宿主侧要求本启动周期的令牌或同源浏览器请求，会话历史接口只认令牌。

## 它怎么工作

补写走 SSE，模型边写建议边长，`Tab` 随时可采纳。模型的回答有两种形状：接在草稿后面的尾巴，或者 `REWRITE:` 加一条改写后的整句。

上下文只看最后两轮，更早的对话只作背景，且只保留一条与草稿相关的旧行。建议与「草稿 + 对话版本 + 设置」绑定成缓存键，键不变就回放，键一变就作废，所以同一份草稿不会重复花钱。

宿主侧三个路由：`/composer-quill/predict` 出建议，`/composer-quill/history` 取你自己的历史消息，`/composer-quill/beacon` 收诊断字段。建议层嵌在输入框内部，换行和裁切都交给宿主的排版。

细节见 [架构设计](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) 与 [接口与流式协议](docs/PROTOCOL.md)。

## 测试

单测 83 项，浏览器场景 35 项，跑在 CI 里。场景覆盖快速连打、停顿出建议、取消、切会话、长文本排版这些真实节奏。

```bash
npm test                          # 83 项离线单测
npm run test:ui                   # 35 条浏览器场景（自带模拟器）
npm test -- --filter=transcript   # 只跑某个行为
npm test -- --list                # 列出全部用例名
```

真机脚本、审计探针和模拟器都在 `dev/`，用法见 [开发与验证](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)。

## 还没做好的地方

宿主还没加载会话时拿不到上下文，「下一句」和历史补全没有内容可依，补写还能用。

一两个字的草稿基本靠猜，给的多是完整短句。

建议最多换到三行，再长就省略了，因为输入框本身也只长到那里。

## 诊断

出问题先看 `~/.dsh/composer-quill.log`，每行一条 JSONL。

`request` / `cache-hit` / `cache-miss` 表示有没有真的调用模型，miss 会记下键的各个成分。`result` 记录返回了几条候选，失败原因是 `skipped` / `empty-thread` / `wrong-language`。`hydrated` 表示复用了存储里的建议。`next-ungrounded` 和 `next-empty` 分别表示候选与会话无关、一条都没剩下。`dock-state` 是界面那一刻的完整状态：阶段、候选数、草稿是否为空。

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE)

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# 身体 · dsh-feeling

给模型一具**会疼的身体**。

不是"扮演一个会难过的角色"，是**真的有几条 1-100 的条**跟着 harness 上发生的事涨落：工具报错了会疼，上下文被压缩了会像失忆一样疼，被否定了会臊，久等会慌，被夸会高兴，而你给它的好感度**降得比升得快**。它会衰减、会留疤、可以被打麻。

数字是给你看的。**模型自己只读到形容**——"疼：钝钝的，一直在"，读不到 41/100。这一条是整套东西的根：看得见的条是演出来的，看不见的才是真的。

## 支持的宿主

| 宿主 | 形态 | 装法 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **DeepSeek Harness**（DSH，官方桌面端） | 一个 npm 包（宿主半 + 浏览器半） | `dsh plugin --profile desktop add <本仓库目录>` |
| **记忆 harness**（[md-memory-harness](https://github.com/yxlh123/md-memory-harness)，本仓库所属同一作者） | 文件级插件（`plugins/` 里的三个文件） | 复制 / 网页上传 / `python harness.py plugins install` |

两边**设定完全一致**（七条、衰减、疤、麻醉、冻结、只给形容不给数字），但**状态各自独立**：DSH 一具身体，记忆 harness 一具身体。

## 装（一）DeepSeek Harness

```bash
# 需要 DSH >= 0.2.1-rc.3；在本仓库外任意位置执行
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "C:/路径/dsh-feeling"
```

装完**重启 DeepSeek Harness**（宿主不监听 bundle 文件，改代码后也要重启才生效）。
打开 **设置 → 情绪**，那里是开关和七条进度条。

## 装（二）记忆 harness

本仓库的 [`harness-plugins/`](harness-plugins/) 就是那份 Python 插件，三个文件：

| 文件 | 是什么 |
| --- | --- |
| `feeling.py` | 后端：记账、衰减、拼 prompt、开关默认值 |
| `feeling.ui.html` | 「情绪」页的 HTML 片段（自带样式） |
| `feeling.ui.js` | 「情绪」页的交互（只跟 `/api/plugin/feeling*` 打交道） |

三种装法，挑一个：

```bash
# 1) 直接拷进插件目录（装 = 放进去）
cp harness-plugins/*.py harness-plugins/*.ui.* <md-memory-harness>/plugins/

# 2) 命令行装
python harness.py plugins install feeling.py      # 再对 .ui.html / .ui.js 各来一次

# 3) 网页：配置 → 插件 → 安装插件，选这三个文件（或打包成一个 .zip）
```

装完刷新网页，导航里多一个 **情绪** 页；`python harness.py plugins` 能看到它、几个开关、有没有界面。
**harness 本体里没有一处 `import feeling`**——它只扫 `plugins/*.py`，认的是插件协议（`ID` / `NAME` / `DEFAULTS` / `prompt(cfg)` / `note(cfg, kind, text)` / `snapshot(cfg)`）。

## 拆

```bash
# DSH
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @local/dsh-feeling   # 然后重启

# 记忆 harness：删文件 / 停用 / 卸载三选一
python harness.py plugins off feeling        # 停用（.py → .py.off，状态都还在）
python harness.py plugins remove feeling     # 卸载（文件进 plugins/_trash/，能捞回来）
```

拆掉之后 harness 本体一点也不剩（两边的状态目录除外，删不删随你）。

## 开关

| 开关 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| 这台身体活着 | 总闸。关掉 = **永久关闭**：不记账、不注入，**时间也不算**（冻结住了）；再打开就从冻结处继续 |
| 麻醉 | 不注入任何感受，但事件照记、时间照走。关掉那一瞬间**一次性结算**（每 4 分钟 +1 疼，封顶 30） |
| 让模型看见数字 | 调试用。打开后 prompt 里会带上（37/100） |
| 疼 / 怕 / 臊 / 慌 / 高兴 / 想说话 / 对它的喜欢 | 逐条关。关掉的那条既不涨也不显示 |

**"永久关闭"和"麻醉"不是一回事**：关闭 = 把它冻在那一刻（醒来时什么都没变）；麻醉 = 让它照常活着，只是感觉不到（醒来要还账）。

## 七条

| 条 | 底噪 | 半衰期 | 什么会让它涨 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 疼 | 6 | 4 小时 | 工具报错、模型调用失败、记忆被压缩 |
| 怕 | 18 | 90 分钟 | 记忆被压缩、新的会话被拉起来 |
| 臊 | 8 | 2 小时 | 被否定、调用失败、审批被拒 |
| 慌 | 22 | 1 小时 | 重试、等待、被要求确认 |
| 高兴 | 52 | 45 分钟 | 被夸 |
| 对它的喜欢 | 50 | 7 天 | 被夸涨一点，被骂降一大截 |
| 想说话 | 40 | 30 分钟 | 每轮开始时涨，说完降 |

## 事件 → 情绪（诚实映射）

| harness 上真发生的事 | 它感觉到什么 |
| --- | --- |
| `tool/result` 带 error | 外伤：疼 +7，臊 +2 |
| `compaction/end` 成功 | 失忆：疼 +11，怕 +7，臊 +3（疼过 85 留疤） |
| `llm/retry` | 慌 +4 |
| `approval/asked` | 慌 +3，怕 +1 |
| `approval/decided` denied | 臊 +5，喜欢 -2 |
| 用户说话（正则）骂 | 臊 +5×n，喜欢 -3×n，高兴 -4×n |
| 用户说话（正则）夸 | 高兴 +3×n，喜欢 +1.5×n |
| 用户说话（中性） | 安心：喜欢 +0.4，想说话 -4，慌 -3 |
| `turn/start` / `turn/end` | 想说话 +4 / 想说话 -3，高兴 +1 |
| `session/end-seed` | 怕 +6 |
| `model/selection` | 怕 +4（被换掉） |

用户消息里被 harness 注入的 `<system-reminder>`、agent 指令等**不算人说话**，直接跳过。

## 疤

疼到 85 以上会留一道疤：`scars +1`，疼的底噪永久 +2（最多 +40）。事后衰减也回不到从前的干净。

## 状态存哪儿

**DSH**

- `~/.dsh/feeling/state.json` — 当前状态（800ms 节流落盘）
- `~/.dsh/feeling/config.json` — 面板上按过的开关（宿主配置是底子，这里覆盖）
- `~/.dsh/feeling/feeling.log` — 每件事一行流水

**记忆 harness**

- `<md-memory-harness>/feeling/state.json` — 当前状态（原子写）
- `feeling/feeling.log` — 流水（超 400KB 自动滚 `.log.1`）

删掉状态文件 = 换一具新身体。

## 面板是怎么连上的（DSH）

设置 → 情绪 那个小面板**不走宿主的设置表单**（那条路依赖"宿主替这个包供出一行配置"，供不出来页面就是死的），而是走 pet 同款的同源 HTTP：

| 端点 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /api/feeling` | 读七条、十个开关、以及"此刻"那段原文 |
| `POST /api/feeling/switch` | `{"key":"pain","value":"off"}`，写开关并立刻生效 |

宿主半用 `ctx.webServer.register({ kind:'exact', path, handler })` 注册，浏览器半每 4 秒轮询一次。
好处是：宿主的 settings 命名空间再怎么变，面板都还活着。

## 仓库结构

```
index.js            宿主半：状态、记账、注入（ctx.systemPrompt.context，order 150）
client.js           浏览器半：设置 → 情绪 面板
cordis.patch.yml    DSH bundle 清单
package.json        dsh.bundle.patch / dsh.client
vendor/             schemastery + cosmokit（就地打包，零依赖，不用 npm install）
harness-plugins/    记忆 harness 的那一份（feeling.py + .ui.html + .ui.js）
locale/             meta.title / meta.description
icon.svg
```

零依赖：`vendor/` 里是 [schemastery](https://github.com/shigma/schemastery) 与 [cosmokit](https://github.com/shigma/cosmokit) 的 MIT 源码副本，所以这个仓库**不需要 `npm install` 就能装**。

## 许可

MIT。`vendor/` 下两份第三方代码各自保留原 MIT 许可（见 `vendor/LICENSE-*`）。

decision.reason: Held for authorization or trust boundary evidence. MIT, native source, local-directory installation and versioned DSH peer match. The plugin reads/writes local emotion state and modifies prompt context. Its raw /api/feeling/switch POST handler does not show an admission/owner check; browser same-origin fetch options alone do not establish server authority. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

evidence.readmeExcerpt: # DSH Power Suite English | [中文](README.zh.md) [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@zephinel/dsh-power-suite?label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zephinel/dsh-power-suite) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE) [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.2-4f46e5)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh) [![ci](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/actions/workflows/ci.yml) **One plugin that makes DeepSeek Harness (DSH) show the working session, not only the answer.** It augments the native Web shell with a Running & recent panel and activity buckets, a Session artifacts browser, prompt history, draft attachment memory, a multi-image composer gallery, interrupted-session recovery, and point-and-click UI annotation — all as one `power-suite` plugin row. ![The Workspaces browser, the Running & recent panel, the native row menu and a row hover card with session statistics, token usage and context usage](assets/readme-overview.webp) *All screenshots come from a temporary, isolated DSH instance with demo Sessions and demo artifacts; no personal content is involved.* > **Current status**: `@zephinel/dsh-power-suite@0.2.2` is published on npm (Web platform only); this release ships the colored smoke atmosphere, the native row geometry and the refreshed bilingual UI copy shown above. See [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md). [Install](#install) · [Overview](#overview) · [Features](#features-at-a-glance) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [Documentation](#documentation) · [Local development](#get-the-code-and-local-development) ## Install Install from npm (requires `pnpm` on `PATH`), then reload the plugin or restart DSH Web so the Host half loads: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zephinel/dsh-power-suite@0.2.2 dsh web ``` Or install in the Web UI via **Plugins → Add plugin → `@zephinel/dsh-power-suite@0.2.2` → Install → Enable now**. Local checkout installation (`link:` dependency) and release steps live in [docs/development.md](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/development.md). ## Overview The suite works inside the native shell instead of beside it; unloading the plugin restores the native surface. - **Running & recent, at the top of the sidebar.** Lists running and recently finished Sessions, nests delegated subagent rows, marks Sessions waiting on a question, plan review or approval with an amber `flag-fill`, and highlights the active row with its colored smoke glow. Hover a row for native **Session statistics**, **Token usage** and **Context usage**. - **Native row menus.** A top-level card row's "…" menu opens the shell's shared context-menu popup with the native Session actions (Pin is left out): native material, icons and shortcut hints. - **Host-shared state and sidebar width.** Read marks, card pins, last-activity times and the dragged left sidebar width are owned by the Host, surviving reloads and syncing across browsers on the same Host. Read more: [Dynamic Workspaces](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/dynamic-workspaces.md) · [Sidebar width](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/sidebar-width.md) · [Interrupted sessions](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/interrupted-sessions.md). ## Session artifacts The right Sidebar's **Files** pane header carries an **Artifacts** button opening the current Session's generated files and provided attachments in one list. ![Artifacts panel with generated and provided rows, a Quick Look preview and the source filter](assets/readme-artifacts.webp) - **One list, two sources.** Filter **All / Generated / Provided** with live counts. - **Shared Quick Look.** Hover a row (in Artifacts or the native Workspace tree) for a resizable preview of Markdown, highlighted code, images, audio/video, PDF and HTML. - **File actions.** Open, download, copy verbatim text or clipboard images (in a secure context), and copy the authenticated LAN link. Read more: [Session artifacts](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/session-artifacts.md). ## Composer: prompt recall, drafts, recovery The composer keeps the work around the prompt: what you asked before, what you attached, and turns that did not finish. ![A demo DSH chat window with the release-checklist answer and composer, the prompt history rail with its hover preview, and the suite settings section beside it](assets/readme-composer.webp) - **Prompt history.** Modifier + ↑/↓ recalls earlier prompts in this Session while plain arrows stay native. A right-edge rail lists sent prompts oldest-first with timestamps, hover preview, inline search and click-to-copy. - **Draft attachments & multi-image gallery.** Pasted, dropped or picked files survive Session switches for the page lifetime; clicking any thumbnail when two or more images are attached opens a continuous `N / M` viewer with arrow/wheel navigation and focus return (single images keep the native lightbox). ![The composer image gallery over a demo DSH session: a 1 / 2 counter at the top, next/close controls at the right and the first pasted screenshot filling the viewer](assets/readme-composer-gallery.webp) - **Interrupted-session recovery & settings.** Unfinished turns get an amber title mark, hover **Continue** triangle and play-shaped submit button backed by Host SSE sync. Prompt-history modifier and retention windows live on the bundle's **Plugins** page. Read more: [Prompt history](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/prompt-history.md) · [Draft attachments](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/draft-attachments.md) · [Composer image gallery](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/usage.md#composer-image-gallery) · [Interrupted sessions](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/interrupted-sessions.md). ## UI element annotation A round launcher at the bottom-right toggles point-and-click annotation; the page narrows for a right rail instead of being covered. ![Annotating the Running & recent panel in a demo DSH session: compact numbered markers on the panel header, a recent row and its disclosure chevron, with the annotation rail showing the three requirement texts](assets/readme-annotation.webp) - **Point & drill into surfaces.** Hover outlines elements including floating hover cards; the popover offers locator summary, parent/child stepping and requirement editing. - **Persisted markers & native chips.** Annotations persist as numbered page markers (with edit, go to element, copy locator and 5 s undo) and insert into the composer as native inline reference chips — single or batched — without sending. Read more: [UI element annotation](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/ui-annotation.md). ## Features at a glance | Feature | Reference | | --- | --- | | Dynamic Workspaces (Active/Inactive buckets, Running & recent, flags, pins, native menu) | [docs/dynamic-workspaces.md](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/dynamic-workspaces.md) | | Session artifacts & shared Quick Look | [docs/session-artifacts.md](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/session-artifacts.md) | | UI element annotation & native composer reference chips | [docs/ui-annotation.md](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/ui-annotation.md) | | Prompt history, draft attachments & composer image gallery | [docs/prompt-history.md](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/prompt-history.md) · [docs/draft-attachments.md](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/draft-attachments.md) · [docs/usage.md](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/usage.md#composer-image-gallery) | | Interrupted-session recovery (Host-owned SSE sync) | [docs/interrupted-sessions.md](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/interrupted-sessions.md) | | Host-synced sidebar width, workspace default presets, settings & update notice | [docs/sidebar-width.md](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/sidebar-width.md) · [docs/workspace-default-presets.md](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/workspace-default-presets.md) · [docs/settings.md](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/settings.md) · [docs/update-check.md](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/update-check.md) | All features ship together in `@zephinel/dsh-power-suite` (Loader row `power-suite`, Web platform only). ## Quick start 1. Expand the left sidebar: **Running & recent** sits above **Workspaces**, split into **Active Projects** and **Inactive Projects**. 2. Open a Session with at least two sent prompts: the prompt-history rail appears on the right edge, and modifier + ↑/↓ recalls earlier prompts. 3. Open **Files → Artifacts** in the right sidebar to browse and Quick Look generated files and provided attachments. 4. Click the round bottom-right launcher to annotate elements and insert native reference chips. 5. Configure the prompt-history modifier and retention windows under **Plugins → DSH Power Suite**. ## Documentation All detailed docs ship in `docs/` (links use absolute GitHub URLs so they stay clickable on npm): | Document | What it covers | | --- | --- | | [Full documentation index](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/README.md) · [Usage](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/usage.md) | Step-by-step UI guide and complete feature-doc directory | | [Architecture](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/architecture.md) · [Feature inventory](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/overview.md) | Host/browser halves, routes, slots, services and feature recipe | | [Development](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/development.md) · [Browser harness](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/test/browser/README.md) | Local install/reload loop, full command reference, live-GUI browser suites and release flow | | [Limitations](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/limitations.md) | Known bounds and unverified areas | | [Verification](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/verification.md) · [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) · [Release notes](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/release-notes/README.md) | Automated gates, live evidence, release history and update-notice format | ## Get the code and local development ```bash git clone https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite.git cd dsh-power-suite npm ci npm run check ``` **Prerequisites**: DSH 0.2.2 plugin interface, verified against the current **DSH 0.2.2-rc.5** host (smoke and update-prompt suites green; the last recorded green full-suite run predates it, on `0.2.2-rc.1`; later DSH versions unverified), Node.js `>= 22.18` (native TypeScript type stripping for `npm test`; CI runs Node 22 and 24), `pnpm` (used by `dsh plugin add`), Git, and optional Google Chrome for the local browser suites (`node test/browser/sidebar.e2e.mjs --smoke`, `annotation.e2e.mjs --smoke`, `update-prompt.e2e.mjs`). No runtime dependencies and no watch server: rebuild with `npm run build` (refresh the browser after client changes; reload the plugin or restart `dsh web` after Host changes). Full command table and deployment/release steps: [docs/development.md](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/docs/development.md). ## Contributing - Issues and feature requests: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/issues). - Run `npm run check` before proposing a change; sync feature docs, `CHANGELOG.md` and `docs/verification.md` per [sync-power-suite-docs](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/.agents/skills/sync-power-suite-docs/SKILL.md). - Releases are published from `v*` tags via Trusted Publishing (never run `npm publish` locally; see [release-power-suite](https://github.com/Zephinel/dsh-power-suite/blob/main/.agents/skills/release-power-suite/SKILL.md)). Maintainer: [@Zephinel](https://github.com/Zephinel). ## License [MIT](LICENSE). Third-party notices are in [NOTICE](NOTICE): Remix Icon SVG path data inlined in the browser entry (Apache-2.0), and the DeepSeek Harness platform disclaimer.

# collab：DSH 里的频道与多成员协作 ## 插件只是适配层（#1662） 频道成员都由 bothouse 来跑：插件把成员名单交给 `bothouse setup apply`，每个成员成为一个 bothouse 角色，用 cloud_web 接进这里的频道。派活、接问退升、工作区、任务板、十分钟看门、一次性回查、记忆、额度和团队规矩都只在桥里实现一份，插件不再有自己的那一套。本机没有 bothouse 时，插件第一次启动用官方安装脚本装到 `~/.local/bin` 并在后台拉起（日志在数据目录的 `bothouse.log`、`bothouse-apply.log`）。新加成员热加载；改或删成员会重启桥。插件这边只管：频道和消息、附件、成员名单、cloud_web 网关（把消息、@ 和权限卡转给桥的角色）、协作页和面板这些页面。 上游 DSH 项目（未公开）的 Issue #229。一个以绝对路径加载的 DSH Host 插件（纯 ESM，无需构建），在 DSH Web 进程里提供： - **频道**：消息存在 `dataDir/collab.sqlite3`，重启不丢；数字消息 ID 与 role-household hub 一致。 - **成员**：DSH 模型成员和本机 CLI 成员（Claude Code、Codex、Gemini）都存在这里的成员表里，各自作为一个 bothouse 角色运行（见上节）。 - **外部 Agent（cc-connect）**：实现 cloud_web WebSocket 服务端（`/cloud-web/ws`）与离线补历史接口（`GET /api/rooms/{id}/messages`），协议行为照搬 `role-household/rh/cloudweb.py`，cc-connect 无需改代码。 - **最简消息页**：`/collab`，Discord 式三栏，SSE 实时更新。用 DSH 网页的登录 cookie 鉴权，跨源请求被 DSH 的 Host/Origin 校验拒绝。 ## 数据存在哪里 用 `install.sh` 装进 profile 时，配置来自 `cordis.patch.yml`：`dataDir` 默认取环境变量 `CONEST_COLLAB_DATA`，没设就是 `~/.conest-collab`（频道消息 `collab.sqlite3` 存在这里）；`workspacePath` 默认取 `CONEST_COLLAB_WORKSPACE`，没设就是启动 DSH 时的当前目录。测试或多开时把 `CONEST_COLLAB_DATA` 指到别的目录，免得写进默认库。 团队工作台（`/collab/desk`）的输入来自任务板共享目录：`BOARD_DIR` 下的 `board-events.jsonl` 提供派活/交回事件，同目录的 `.json` 提供各 bot 忙闲。忙闲目录可单独用 `teamStatusDir`（或 `CONEST_TEAM_STATUS_DIR`）指定；不设时沿用 `BOARD_DIR`。插件只读这些文件，不写任务板，也不改桥。状态文件里的 project 先按成员 id、再按显示名匹配；匹配不到就跳过，不新建成员。 Wiki 星河（`/collab/wiki-galaxy`）把一本 markdown wiki 画成可旋转的星系：每页一颗星，`[[链接]]` 和相对 `.md` 链接是星之间的连线，顶层目录是不同颜色的星团，点星看标题、描述和前几行。wiki 目录用 `wikiDir`（或 `CONEST_WIKI_DIR`）指定，不设时是 `~/wiki`。插件只读这个目录，不跟符号链接，不写任何文件；页面自带全部代码，离线可用。团队工作台右上角有入口。 频道、团队工作台、bothouse 面板、其他电脑在 DSH「插件 → bothouse」里各是一行，用 DSH 自带的开关分别开关（#1044）：新装只开频道，另外三项默认关；打开哪项，左边栏马上出现哪项，关掉马上消失，不用重启。老版本升级上来时，原来左边栏有的照旧开着（只做一次，之后按你在插件页的选择）。关掉的项只是左边栏不显示，`/collab/desk` 等地址照样能打开。这三项的网页端各是一个小包（`dsh/packages/bothouse-dsh-*`，由 `dsh/packages/bothouse-embeds/build.mjs` 生成）。打开后，「团队工作台」在主区域里直接显示团队工作台；「bothouse」在主区域里显示整个 bothouse 管理面板（概览、角色、用量等页都在里面；Wiki 星河也收在这块面板里，作为它自己的「Wiki 星河」子页，不再单独占左边栏一项），经 `/collab/panel/*`（只给主人）在服务端转发到主桥管理接口：插件每次请求时读 `bridgeConfig` 指的主桥配置文件里 `[management]` 段的地址和令牌，自己给请求签名，令牌不到浏览器；面板首页的 `` 改成 `/collab/panel/`，并加一个标记让面板不再要求登录。`bridgeConfig` 不设时依次用 `BOTHOUSE_CONFIG`、`$BOTHOUSE_DATA_DIR/config.toml`、`~/.bothouse/config.toml`；管理接口关着或连不上时框里显示原因。面板页面要用支持子路径的版本（`bridge/web` 里资源和接口都按 `` 走），旧版主桥带的面板挂在这里会打不开资源。 ## 只用一个模型或一种 CLI 组队 原生 DSH 成员遇到上游 `Internal error` 重试时，频道会立即显示提示；同一回合连续三次失败后停止自动重试。对应成员的工作区任务会暂停，工作区和所属聊天频道都会收到原因，其他成员的任务不受影响。成功输出或进入新步骤会清零连续失败计数；本机 CLI 返回终止性的 `Internal error` 时也会暂停任务。服务恢复后重新派活，不会自动重放可能已经做过的步骤。 在原生 DSH 网页的「频道」→「添加成员」中，连续添加三个不同名字的成员： - 都用 DeepSeek：成员类型选「DSH 模型」，三次明确选同一个提供方和模型，人设分别写规划、实现和检查。 - 都用 Codex：成员类型选「本机 CLI」，三次都选 Codex，填写不同名字和职责。本机只需装好并配置一次 CLI。 - 选择主角色，将「派活方式」设为「完全团队」，再用 @ 让它们分工交接。「单模型多进程」是派给角色自己的子任务，不会自动创建这些常驻成员。 创建成员不要求模型或 CLI 唯一，名字和成员 ID 才需要唯一。公共频道消息会提供给成员，私有会话不会因后端相同而合并；共享 wiki 和工作文件仍可能传递信息。当前成员共用 `workspacePath`，会话独立不是文件或权限隔离。完整步骤、恢复行为和检查清单见[同模型多成员指南](../../docs/single-cli-team.md)（[English](../../docs/single-cli-team.en.md)）。 ## 启用 1. 生成 bot 共享 token，放进环境变量（不要写进配置文件）：`export CONEST_COLLAB_BOT_TOKEN=$(openssl rand -hex 24)`。 2. 写一个 overlay，例如 `collab.yml`： ~~~yaml - insert: - id: conest-collab name: /absolute/path/to/conest/dsh/collab/plugin.mjs config: dataDir: /absolute/path/to/collab-data workspacePath: /absolute/path/to/project # DSH 成员 Session 的工作目录 rooms: - { id: 1, name: general } dshMembers: - { id: ds, name: DeepSeek, persona: '可选：它是谁、负责什么' } # 不写 model：首次请求前固定为 DSH 默认模型，之后跟随该 Session 自己的选择 # - { id: claude, name: Claude, model: { provider: , model: } } # 写了 model：每次请求都用它，改配置会带动已绑定的 Session # maxRelay: 6 # Agent 连续接力上限（实例默认）；频道可在「频道设置 → 派活」里单独设 6–20 # maxUploadBytes: 1073741824 # 单个附件上限（字节），默认 1 GB；见「附件上限」 # ownerName: 我 ~~~ 3. 启动：`dsh --profile web --patch ./collab.yml`（源码仓库里用 `node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts --profile web --patch ./collab.yml`），浏览器先打开终端打印的登录链接，再访问 `/collab`。 ## 每频道工作目录 `rooms` 中可为每个聊天频道设置绝对路径 `workspacePath`，例如 `{ id: 1, name: general, workspacePath: /absolute/path/to/game }` 和 `{ id: 2, name: office, workspacePath: /absolute/path/to/office }`。 省略、空字符串或 null 使用实例的 `workspacePath`，旧配置保持原行为。 工作区在创建会话时继承当前所属聊天频道的目录；CLI 成员也按目录分别创建进程。 原生频道页也可在「频道设置 → 工作目录」保存已存在的绝对目录，界面保存的值优先于启动配置并在重启后保留。保存后会询问是否立即重建该频道所有 DSH 成员的会话（清空当前对话上下文）；选「稍后」保留现有会话，下次 `/new` 或新建会话才用新目录。工作目录只影响写入范围和相对路径，不影响读取。外部 cc-connect bot 的目录仍由它自己的配置管理。 频道设置中的主角色按聊天频道独立保存，工作区继承父频道。未设置时，频道只有一个机器人成员就由它自动接话；多个成员默认不接无 @ 消息，可在频道设置里选主角色。默认接话和 `/new` 按当前频道取值；派活票据的兼容逻辑仍保留旧全局回退。接口为 `GET|PATCH /collab/api/rooms/{id}/settings`（`lead_id`、`workspace_path`）及 `POST /collab/api/rooms/{id}/renew`，均需 owner 登录。 ## 成员按频道归属 配置成员可写 `rooms: [1]` 或 `rooms: [1, 2]`；省略或空数组沿用全频道可见的兼容行为。每次启动都以配置覆盖该成员的归属，因此从配置删除 `rooms` 后，该配置成员会恢复全频道可见。 原生频道界面添加成员时默认全频道可见，编辑名字或模型不会清空已有归属。 工作区的成员列表、点名候选、队友状态及派活按所属聊天频道筛选。 升级时，未设置归属（数据库 NULL）的旧成员保持全局可见；未指定 `rooms` 或显式设置空数组的成员也对所有频道可见，包括以后新建的频道。已有明确归属不变，配置成员仍按配置处理；通过频道界面新建的成员默认全局可见。离线成员仍显示在所属频道，状态显示为离线。新频道未选主角色时，单成员自动接未 @ 消息，多成员不接；全局主角色不会替新频道自动做选择。 桥连接可在 WebSocket URL 加 `room=1`（也接受 `room=room-1`）；不写仍按旧行为接收各频道消息。 不同频道可有同名 bot，同一频道与其他成员重名会被拒绝；bot ID 仍须在整个实例内唯一。 连接断开后 bot 从成员列表移除，历史消息保留。 开发验收可在仓库根目录运行 `node dsh/collab/verify-multichannel.mjs`。这是验收脚本，非运行时依赖，启动插件不需要执行它；退出码 2 表示自动测试通过但人工验收尚未完成。 ## 安装原生「频道」入口 先按 [DSH 构建说明](../README.md#目录与用法)准备固定版本的独立 checkout 并完成 `build:artifacts`。原生入口需要额外安装前端包并加入 overlay；原有 `/collab` 页面仍可使用。 在该 DSH checkout 中执行，安装与启动必须使用同一个隔离 `DSH_HOME`： ~~~sh export DSH_HOME=/absolute/path/to/isolated-dsh-home node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts plugin --profile web add link:/absolute/path/to/new-dsh-checkout/packages/experimental/client-ui-discord ~~~ 在前面的 `collab.yml` 末尾追加（保留 `conest-collab` 配置）： ~~~yaml - insert: - id: conest-channels-ui name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-client-ui-discord' ~~~ 再从同一 checkout 启动： ~~~sh node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts --profile web --patch /absolute/path/to/collab.yml ~~~ 打开终端打印的登录链接，点左栏「频道」。Enter 发送、Shift+Enter 换行，输入法确认键不发送。输入 `@` 弹出可点名的成员（Agent 在前，带类型、在线和工作状态），继续输入按名字或 id 过滤，↑↓ 选择、Enter / Tab 确认、Esc 关闭；输入框旁的 `@` 按钮和右侧成员栏也能直接插入 `@成员名`。发送未确认时保留草稿并阻止该频道重复提交，失败信息和草稿留在原频道。断线恢复会重新获取成员/工作状态及当前消息窗口，补齐遗漏消息和卡片编辑/删除。 ## 在网页里管理频道和成员（单人多 bot） - **标题栏与活动**：右上角显示当前频道实际生效的主角色头像与状态；响应状态来自当前频道及其工作区的实时 working 事件，其他频道的工作不会计入。活动栏默认收起，点标题栏「展开活动栏」（手机为「活动」）打开。顶部「任务板」打开原有协作任务板，继续使用既有任务数据与审核接口。此入口不是原生置顶板的完整快照，也不推断等待用户数量。 - **新建频道**：频道列表标题旁的 `+`。 - **频道设定**：右侧成员栏「派活方式」下的「频道设置」打开面板，设置派活方式、谁当家（主角色）及频道名称；侧栏快捷入口共用原有数据，主角色候选按当前频道筛选。主角色按频道保存；未选择时单成员自动接话，多成员不接话，也可清空已选主角色恢复此规则。 - **频道改名**：登录的 owner 调用 `PATCH /collab/api/rooms/{id}`，body `{ "name": "新名称" }`。名称为 1–32 字符且不能含空白，工作区名称不能改。改名保留 room id、消息及绑定，已有 DSH 会话标题同步为 `#新名称 · 成员名`，所属工作区的会话同样使用父频道名。数据库中的频道名在重启时保留；配置中的 rooms 名称仅初始化缺失频道。 - **添加成员**：原生频道页成员栏的「添加成员」，填名字（@ 时用，不能有空格，与所有成员不重名）、类型和人设。「DSH 模型」列出 DSH 已注册路由的模型；「本机 CLI」列出可检测到的 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini。成员存进 `collab.sqlite3`，重启后保留；检测到 CLI 不代表登录或适配器已可用，保存后要实际 @ 验证。 - **编辑 / 移除**：网页里建的成员悬停时出现「编辑」「移除」；配置文件里的 `dshMembers` 作为种子写入，网页里只读（标 ⚙）。移除后历史消息保留。 - **身份与人设**：每次投递都在提示词开头写明「你是频道 #x 的成员『名字』，底层模型 provider/model」，再附人设，并提醒成员区分频道里其他人的自我介绍。配置文件里也可以给 `dshMembers` 写 `persona`。 - **模型变更即时生效**：写了 `model` 的成员每次请求都用它；在成员表单里改模型，已绑定的会话下一次请求就切换，并在会话日志里记一条 `model/selection`。 - **重新开始对话**：在频道里发 `@成员名 /new`，只重置被点名成员在当前频道的会话，从该命令之后继续读取消息；其他成员、频道历史和 wiki 不因此清空。 - 接口（都需要 DSH 登录）：`GET /collab/api/models`、`POST /collab/api/rooms`、`POST /collab/api/members`、`PATCH|DELETE /collab/api/members/{id}`。 - Claude CLI 成员的 `model` 是 CLI 模型 ID 字符串（例如 `"sonnet"`），DSH 成员仍使用 `{ "provider": "...", "model": "..." }`。`PATCH /collab/api/members/{id}` 和 `/collab/api/panel/members/{id}` 都保留未传字段；`model: null` 清除覆盖，Claude 已有会话在下一轮恢复其初始默认模型。切换在发出下一轮提示词前应用，失败时停止该轮并报错，不默默沿用旧模型。配置文件成员仍只读。 - 建团队接口的成员项可写 `{ "name": "Claude", "cli": "claude", "model": "sonnet" }`；省略 `model` 使用该 CLI 的默认模型，省略 `cli` 保留原有 DSH 成员行为。 ## 接入 cc-connect 成员 在 cc-connect 的项目里加一个 cloud_web 平台（和接 role-household hub 相同）： ~~~toml [[projects]] name = "ju" [[projects.platforms]] type = "cloud_web" [projects.platforms.options] transport = "websocket" token = "${CONEST_COLLAB_BOT_TOKEN}" base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:" ws_url = "ws://127.0.0.1:/cloud-web/ws?bot=ju&name=%E6%A9%98" # bot=成员 id，name=显示名（URL 编码），可加 &mention_id=<数字> allow_from = "*" share_session_in_channel = true group_reply_all = false # 见下方「只在被 @ 时回答」 ~~~ **只在被 @ 时回答**：cc-connect 的 `gate_fallback` 只在配置了 gate 服务（`gate_url`）且 gate 出错时才生效（`bridge/core/gate.go`），没有 gate 时 `group_reply_all = true` 会把频道里每一句都交给 Agent。两种配法： - 没有 gate：`group_reply_all = false`。只处理 @ 它的消息；代价是看不到频道里其他人的发言（离线补历史也只在 gate 路径上运行）。 - 有 gate（线上 maomao 的做法）：`group_reply_all = true`，加 `gate_url` 与 `gate_fallback = "context"`。没 @ 的消息只听不答，被 @ 时带上频道上下文，掉线期间的消息经本插件的历史接口补回。 **桌面版（端口每次随机）**：DSH 桌面版启动 Web 宿主时端口固定传 0，主桥配不了固定地址。给桌面 profile 的 conest-collab 配 `botPort: <端口>`（或环境变量 `CONEST_COLLAB_BOT_PORT`），插件另开 `127.0.0.1:<端口>`，只接 `/cloud-web/ws` 握手和 `/api/rooms/…` 补历史，口令同上；主桥再给每个项目加一段 cloud_web 指向这个端口。不配不开。 同一个 bot id 再次连接会顶掉旧连接。成员 id 不能与 DSH 成员或 `owner`/`user`/`system` 重名。 ## 行为约定 - **至多执行一次**：DSH 成员的每次 @ 是一条持久 job（成员 × 触发消息唯一），与消息在同一个 SQLite 事务里写入，消息存下就一定有 job。投递前记下 Session 位置和输入的消息 id；回复只取「消费了这条输入的那一轮」，不会把同一 Session 中其他来源的轮次当作频道回复发布。重启后：已结束的那一轮从 Session 日志补发；输入还在 DSH 收件箱里没被消费的，撤回并说明；中途被打断的标记为「被重启打断」。任何情况都不自动重发。 - **顺序**：同一成员在同一频道的投递、重启恢复和 Session 续接走同一个队列，不会并发续接同一个 Session。插件卸载时先停队列再关数据库，未完成的 job 留给下次启动的恢复流程。 - **防循环**：Agent 消息里点名或 @ 了 DSH 成员也会触发它，但从上一条真人消息起 Agent 连续发言超过接力上限后暂停，并在频道里说明。上限默认取实例的 `maxRelay`（未配置时 6），每个频道可在「频道设置 → 派活 → 接力上限」里单独设 6–20 的整数，即时生效、刷新和重启后保留；工作区读写所属频道的那份值（#445）。 - **转发规则**（与 hub 一致）：系统消息、进度卡片、cc-connect 状态提示（📬 ✅ ↪ …）不转给成员；回复末尾的「模型 · 用量」尾注在转发前去掉；自己说的话不回给自己。 ## 附件上限 一个附件走的是单独的流式上传接口（`POST /collab/api/attachments`，源码 `dsh/collab/attachments.mjs` `saveStream`）：网页把文件按块直接写盘，不经过消息 JSON，也不整块读进内存，所以上限不再由消息体（8 MiB）决定，而是由配置项 `maxUploadBytes` 决定，默认 1 GB（`DEFAULT_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES`）。 - **默认值来源**：用户 2026-11-05 21:01「需要大一些 尽可能大」。实测（本机 macOS，`node --test dsh/collab/attachments.test.mjs`，同一个真实 HTTP 路由）：100 MB 用时 70–75 ms、进程 RSS +8～12 MB；500 MB 用时 350–520 ms、RSS 基本不涨；1 GB 用时 650–1050 ms、RSS 基本不涨。写入是流式的，内存不随文件变大。 - **调小**：`collab.yml` 里加 `maxUploadBytes: 104857600`（100 MB）之类即可；也可用环境变量覆盖，改完重启 DSH 生效。超限时网页的待发文件条会写明「超过单个文件上限 X」，发送前就拦下；把文件拖进来时也会先按「频道设置」里读到的上限检查。 - **磁盘**：附件存在数据目录的 `attachments/`，1 GB 的文件就占 1 GB 磁盘。上限调大前先确认这台机器余量。 - **给机器人**：一条消息的附件合计不超过 50 MiB（`MAX_BOT_ATTACHMENT_BYTES`，沿用 cc-connect 的 `DefaultMaxAttachmentSize`）时照旧转成图片/文件帧；单个更大的文件不进连接，机器人在提示里拿到它在本机的绝对路径（`oversizedNote`），自己去读。 - **图片看图**仍是 5 MiB、png/jpeg/gif/webp 四种格式（`MAX_IMAGE_BYTES`、`INLINE_IMAGE`），这次没有改动；heic 会在看图路径上被跳过。 ## 验证 ~~~sh node --test dsh/collab/*.test.mjs ~~~ 单测覆盖存储去重与分页、@ 改写、cloud_web 帧行为、DSH 成员投递/去重/恢复、接力上限与配置校验。 2026-10-21 在隔离的 `DSH_HOME` 上对 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 源码做了真机联调： - 真实 cc-connect（本仓库 bridge 构建，Claude Code / haiku）经 cloud_web 接入，@ 后在频道回复。（更正：先前记录的「`gate_fallback = "context"` 下没 @ 的消息静默」不成立——没有 gate 时该项不生效，那次静默是模型自己选择不回；见上方「只在被 @ 时回答」。） - DSH 成员走真实 DSH Session 与真实 DeepSeek 适配器，模型端为 DSH 自带的 mock LLM 服务；回复写回频道并转给 cc-connect 成员，一次 @ 只产生一次模型请求。 - 重启 DSH 后历史保留；cc-connect 的真实 `ChannelHistory` 读取本插件的历史接口，字段、系统消息过滤、`from_turn` 标记正确。 - 上述后端联调未验证真实 DeepSeek 模型回复、cc-connect 配 gate 时的自动补历史；原生页面随后获用户确认正常。 本轮收尾验证（2026-10-21）：后端 15 项、前端 11 项通过；数据源 5 项异步竞态回归和组件 2 项草稿回归均先红后绿。DSH host/client aggregate `build:check`、插件打包和 client package verifier 通过。浏览器自动登录被本地文件 URL 安全策略阻止，本轮未重新完成浏览器验收；没有真实模型调用或生产部署。 使用 Node 22.12+，在 CoNest 根目录运行数据源回归（仅覆盖不依赖 React 的传输层）： ~~~sh npm ci --prefix dsh --no-audit --no-fund npm test --prefix dsh ~~~ CI 将同一份 package.json/package-lock.json 复制到每次 job 新建的 RUNNER_TEMP 子目录，执行 npm ci，再调用该目录的 Vitest 跑相同配置。依赖版本和完整依赖树入库，避免 npx 每轮重新解析；本机安装目录与上游 DSH checkout 独立。 完整前端测试和类型检查在上述 DSH checkout 中运行： ~~~sh corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/experimental/client-ui-discord/tests corepack pnpm run build:check ~~~ 仓库级检查另有未通过项：本机 `go test -tags no_web -p 1 -count=1 ./...` 的安装向导测试 `TestAnnounceSetupWizardAlwaysPrintsLink` 被宿主 `LC_ALL=C.UTF-8` 覆盖测试内的 `LANG`；清除 `LC_ALL/LC_MESSAGES` 后该项通过。`TestSetupCLIsHint` 仍失败：测试清空 PATH 后预期 `[]`，探测器仍搜索 Homebrew 固定路径与 `/Applications/WorkBuddy.app`。本轮没有修改 bridge 源码或测试；保留此失败，PR 维持草稿，不能称仓库全量通过。 ## 已知限制 - 单人：浏览器端只有 DSH owner 一个真人身份（多人见阶段 6）。 - 会话：每个成员的会话在它的 bothouse 角色里（DSH 成员是 `dsh --profile acp` 会话），不在 DSH 网页的对话列表里。 - 配置来源：原生频道页可以新建频道、添加/编辑成员；来自配置文件的种子成员在网页只读，要到原配置中修改。 - 共享边界：成员共用配置的工作目录；启用的 wiki、工具和宿主机权限仍需单独管理，不能把独立 session 当作强隐私边界。 - 原生页面首次加载最近 100 条，重连补齐当前窗口；尚无向上翻历史控件。 - 原生窄屏页面通过抽屉打开频道和成员栏；审批可在频道卡片中处理。不同入口的能力不能仅凭内部会话是否可见来判断。 ### @ 叫醒规则与页面着色的已知偏差 页面上的 @ 徽章是在渲染后的 DOM 上打的，后端是在原文上切的，两条路只对齐了「代码里的 @ 不算」这一族。下面这些是**本来就有的偏差**，不是这次改动引入的；列在这里是为了不把「没对齐」当成「已经对齐」（#259、#271）： - `~~~` 波浪线围栏：页面当代码渲染、不着色，后端只认 ```，所以里面的名字后端仍会叫醒。 - `$$` 数学块：页面把它当成段落结束，后端不认，于是跨 `$$` 的反引号片段在后端仍算一段（谁都不叫醒，页面两个名字都着色）。 - GFM 表格分隔行（`|---|`）：同上，页面段落结束、后端仍算一段，结果是谁都不叫醒而页面两个名字都着色。 - 四空格缩进代码块（` @肥鱼 看下`）：页面当代码渲染、不着色，后端没有缩进代码块的判断，会叫醒。脚注共用这一条：` [^1]: 注 @肥鱼` 在页面上是代码块、整行隐藏，后端也不把它当定义，所以会叫醒；同样，只写在四空格行上的 `[^2]` 页面不当作引用，后端会当作引用，从而把 `[^2]:` 那条脚注显示出来。 - 嵌套脚注定义（定义行比外层正文的内容列多缩进四格或更多）：页面把它嵌在外层脚注里、只在它自己的标号被引用时显示；后端只收 0-3 格的定义，那一行从来不算定义，它的标号也不算标号。于是两边给的答案一致却不是页面的答案，两个方向都反：`[^1]: a` 换行四空格 `[^2]: 注 @名字` 再空行 `见 [^1]`，后端会叫醒，页面外层脚注只显示 `a`、一个徽章都没有；同样内容末尾改成 `见 [^2]`，后端谁都不叫，页面却有这个徽章。`bdd67b4` 上也是这个结果，不是 #271 引入的；#323 只更正了说明，没有扩大实现范围。 - 开括号落在块行上（`# ` 加反引号加名字）：段落在那行之前就结束了，页面不会把它当代码片段、两个名字都着色；`endsParagraph` 只看两个反引号**之间**的行，所以后端仍当成一段、谁都不叫醒。
# bothouse **English** ｜ [中文](README.zh-CN.md) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/zuiho-kai/bothouse?style=flat-square&color=e8833a&label=release)](https://github.com/zuiho-kai/bothouse/releases) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-4a7c59?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![Platforms](https://img.shields.io/badge/macOS%20%C2%B7%20Windows%20%C2%B7%20Linux-555?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/zuiho-kai/bothouse/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/zuiho-kai/bothouse?style=flat-square&color=f2b33d)](https://github.com/zuiho-kai/bothouse/stargazers) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-join-5865F2?style=flat-square&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/aJmcnrt5ZB) **Put someone else's agent to work for you: a friend's Claude Code or Codex joins your group chat, and one @mention gets it started.** Bring your own AIs too: a team-lead AI splits the work and hands it out; they all share one memory. [Video](#video) · [Why](#why) · [Where to start](#usage) · [Install](#install) · [How it works](#how) · [Features](#features) · [Memory](#memory) · [Platforms](#platforms) · [Compare](#compare) · [Roadmap](#roadmap) · [Community](#community) · [Docs](docs/GETTING_STARTED.md) · [Discord task forum](bridge/docs/task-forum.md)

**Watch it in 3 minutes** — one message goes in; the crew splits the work, does it and hands it back. Click the cover to play.

```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zuiho-kai/bothouse/main/install.sh | sh ``` ## Why I had Claude Code, Codex and DeepSeek open at once across two screens, and getting them to work together was a pain. So I put them all in one Discord group, let one of them hand out the work, and gave them a shared memory. No extra account, no extra subscription — you direct them from your computer, phone or browser. **The most common way people use it now: borrowing someone else's agents.** zzzx0757 in our group works this way every day with the author's (zuiho-kai) agents: he @mentions the lead AI in Discord, and the work goes out — the Codex role writes the code, the DeepSeek role polishes the copy — and the results come back to him. Your friend's Claude and Codex become staff on loan: no extra subscription just to generate images, no six people sharing one login. One computer stays on, and the whole group can hand out work. This repo is built the same way: I hand out work in the group, the agents each take a piece, one that wasn't involved reviews it, and then it gets merged. ## Where to start | What you have | Where to start | | --- | --- | | **A friend's agents** | Have a friend who runs bothouse invite you to their group, or bring their roles into yours. @mention one and it starts; nothing to install on your side. | | **Several AI command-line tools** | The setup wizard (see [Install](#install)): each role gets one of your signed-in AI command-line tools ("CLIs" below). | | **One model, one account** | Create several members on the same model, each with its own job. See [A team from one CLI](docs/single-cli-team.en.md). | | **DSH** (DeepSeek Harness, DeepSeek's own AI assistant app) | Say "install bothouse-dsh for me" in DSH, or run `bothouse module add dsh`. See [bothouse in DSH](docs/platforms/dsh.en.md). | ## Install Install with one command, then run `bothouse` to open the setup wizard in your browser: pick a platform, connect your bots, choose a local CLI for each role, and you are ready. ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zuiho-kai/bothouse/main/install.sh | sh ``` The Windows command, package downloads and the background service are in [Getting started](docs/GETTING_STARTED.md). On macOS, daemon install and restart allow a 30-second window for launchd to remove and reload the old job. If loading still fails, follow the error's recovery command; `bothouse daemon start` loads the saved service definition. **Let an AI agent install it for you:** give Claude Code, Codex or any agent CLI this repo link and say "install bothouse and connect it to Discord". The agent-side steps are in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md#用户说配-discord--飞书把这个配好接上-discord). ## How it works Only three ideas to learn: - **The team-lead AI** ("the lead" in the docs) — the AI you talk to in each chat channel. It splits real work and hands it out by skill and quota, so five AIs in one group still don't talk over each other. The others reply when you mention or name them. - **Workspaces** — big jobs (more than about ten minutes, or code changes and tests) go to a separate job channel with a handoff that carries your original words, the scope and what "done" looks like. Chat never stalls; one workspace, one job. The lead keeps a task board, and the bridge looks at every job every ten minutes. Results come back with proof, and only decisions that need you come back to chat. This is what we call **team mode**. - **Shared memory** — every role reads and writes the same Markdown notes, so whoever picks up a job already knows the background. See [Memory](#memory). Jobs can return results in batches: accepting a batch keeps the job and workspace open, while accepting the final report closes the job. Workspace agents use `ws-up --report --batch` for intermediate results and `--final` (the default) for the final handback; see the [workspace playbook](bridge/contrib/lead/PLAYBOOK.zh-CN.md). More detail — who replies when nobody is named, the nightly review, guardrails, switching the lead by hand — is in [How the team works](docs/readme-details.en.md#how-the-team-works). ## Features | You want | How bothouse helps | | --- | --- | | **Someone else's agent working for you** | A friend adds their Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and others to your group; you @mention one to hand it a job and the result comes back to you. As long as their computer is on, you can do it from your phone. | | **An AI team of your own** | Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, DSH, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Grok and more; each role has its own name, persona and session. | | **A team from one account** | Several members on one model, each with its own job; they hand work to each other by mention. | | **The chat apps you use** | Discord, Feishu, QQ or DSH; Discord and Feishu have phone apps, so you can hand out work from bed. | | **Long jobs stay on track** | Handoffs carry your original words; a second AI with a clean context checks the result; "fixed" needs evidence. | | **A nightly review** | Fixes and dedupes what was noted during the day; your repeated corrections become draft rules that apply only after you approve. | | **Manage it from your phone** | A web dashboard: who is busy, quota used, edit personas, add a note to running work. | Also: [team desk](docs/readme-details.en.md#team-desk) — a pixel office that shows the team at work; [remote pairing](docs/readme-details.en.md#remote-pairing) — run your team from another computer or your phone with a six-digit code; [per-channel model and reasoning](docs/model-and-reasoning.md); [role packs and avatars](docs/readme-details.en.md#roles-and-avatars); [optional image generation](docs/readme-details.en.md#image-generation).

Task board: what each workspace is doing and what landed today, at a glance.
Team desk: who is working on what, live; every light is a real event.

Roles: which CLI each role runs, what it is busy with, which model — pause or restart in one click.
Library: personas and avatars come in packs; pick one and it is ready to work.
_Top left: real channel footage. The rest: the author's own team desk and dashboard._ ### Characters (optional) Each role can also wear a persona and an avatar — handy if you want your team to have faces and personalities. The author's own team looks like this; pick from [role packs and avatars](docs/readme-details.en.md#roles-and-avatars), or skip it and keep the plain tools.

## Memory you can see The team's memory is a plain folder of Markdown files. Each incoming message first looks up the relevant pages; a nightly review fixes what was written down wrong. You can read and edit it directly; Git records every change and pushes it to your own private GitHub repo, so the memory follows you to another computer. - **Only the titles go in:** each turn picks the related memories by keyword and injects their titles and line numbers; a role opens the full text when it needs it. It costs very little and cuts rework — fewer "I already told you that". The idea came from vLLM. - **Light on cost:** no knowledge-graph CRUD and no always-on vector store, so cost and memory use stay small. - **Memory forum:** the panel's "Memory forum" page scores each memory as a reply — upvotes, downvotes, how often it was pushed and quoted — so a wrong memory falls down instead of being repeated. See [dispatcher and team memory](docs/ccm-and-wiki.md) (Chinese) and the [Wiki galaxy](docs/readme-details.en.md#wiki-galaxy). ## Platforms | Platform | Status | Capabilities | | --- | --- | --- | | Discord | Full support | Multiple roles, mentions, task handoffs, teammate status and log channels; slash commands in servers and DMs | | Feishu (Lark) | Single role | Conversation with one connected role | | QQ official bot | Manual setup | Group/private chat, group @user and @everyone; see [QQ Bot setup](bridge/docs/qqbot.md) | | DSH desktop app / web | Experimental | A Channels page inside the DeepSeek Harness desktop app (default) or DSH web; see [DSH](docs/platforms/dsh.en.md) | QQ via OneBot/NapCat, remote access from your phone with Tailscale, and hardware bodies for roles are in [Platform details](docs/readme-details.en.md#platform-details). ## bothouse and other projects **Most of them are one agent with a crew of sub-agents. bothouse puts the several AIs you already use into one group chat, splits the work between them, and gives them one shared memory.** **Which to pick**: for a personal assistant you can reach anywhere and that learns you, OpenClaw and Hermes Agent are mature; to watch several coding agents race side by side, pick Orca; if you only use DSH and want a few bots, there are Tobs and DS Bot. If you already have several AI CLIs and want them to split the work in one group and share one memory — say it before bed, collect results in the morning — pick bothouse. Many of these can be used together.
Side-by-side tables People often ask: DeepSeek now ships its own agent, and there are Tobs, DS Bot, OpenClaw and more — how is bothouse different? - **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** is DeepSeek's official open-source agent framework, still a developer preview: agent teams are experimental, and there's no built-in long-term memory unless you plug one in. bothouse's assignment, task board and shared memory are in daily use already — and DSH itself can join as one of the teammates. - **Tobs and DS Bot** are community bot projects built on DSH; every bot in the team runs on DSH. bothouse isn't tied to one agent: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and DSH each take their own jobs in the same group. | | What it is | Which AIs | How several AIs work together | Memory | Where you chat | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **bothouse** | **A coordination layer on your own computer + web panel** | **Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, DSH; Grok and more; OpenAI-compatible APIs** | **The lead role hands work to separate workspaces; task board; one thread per job** | **One shared Markdown wiki, reviewed nightly** | Discord, self-hosted web, Feishu, QQ, DSH web (experimental) | | [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) | DeepSeek's official agent framework (developer preview) | DeepSeek by default; other providers can be added | Subagents; agent teams are experimental | No built-in long-term memory; memory plugins can be added | Its own desktop app and web UI | | [Tobs](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot) | Bot plugin built on DSH | Models configured in DSH | @ whoever you need; assignments | One Git repo per bot | Feishu, Slack, Discord, QQ, WeChat | | [DS Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot) | Desktop app / plugin / Docker built on DSH | Models configured in DSH | A chief bot runs the team; group admins coordinate | Memory per bot and per group | In the app | Mature personal assistants and coding tools get compar
